body:
Before the results come in, I wanted to share with you some of my final thoughts on our campaign.
| | |

| | Peter, When I first decided to run for Congress, I had one goal in mind: **to be a fighter for Oklahoma.** While on the campaign trail and connecting with Oklahomans I believe our message was well-received. I want to start by thanking God, my family, friends, and most of all, the volunteers who have been with us from Day 1. Your faith in me as a candidate means the world. I wouldn't have gotten this far without everyone's support. **No matter what the results may be tonight, I will never stop fighting for Oklahoma. My service to our state will never end.** Everything from this point forward is entirely in God's hands, and I have complete faith in him. Sincerely,

Dustin Roberts Candidate for Congress

body:
The Supreme Court just struck down the right to safe and legal abortion.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47120064/353135026/-1872862983?amount=3&refcode=UD_20220628_EMSPL_E3_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzgxNTI4IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI1Nzc2OGI0LTQ0ZjctZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=5To6ei7L5A2xA9i2fOhIns-KdRtDaguUNiY5vvNjQgk=) Peter —

The Supreme Court has struck down the right to safe and legal abortion, and the protections that generations of Americans were born with are gone. It’s an enormous step back for our country.

In Arizona, Trump just endorsed one of my opponents who wants to go even further and pass a national ban on abortion in all cases — no exceptions. He even opposes the decision that made birth control legal in this country.

The stakes were high before. But after this decision, it’s more critical than ever that we win this race, because the Senate is the final defense against abortion being banned in the United States.

As long as I’m in the Senate, I’ll work to make sure that never happens.

name: Cecile Richards
subject: This photo fills me with hope
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

Jane Roe — the plaintiff of Roe v. Wade — was a Texan. So were both of her
attorneys, Linda Coffee and Sarah Weddington.

Born and raised in Texas, they argued for a woman’s right to choose before
the all-male Supreme Court in 1973.

No one rode to our rescue from outside of Texas. No one saved the day for
us. Texas women showed up, fought back, and won protections for
reproductive rights — not just for themselves but for every woman
nationwide.

Now, 49 years later, Greg Abbott’s extreme trigger law is set to outlaw
all abortions in Texas without exception for rape or incest.

It’s true once again —
nobody is riding in to save us from outside Texas. It’s on you, it’s on
me, it’s on all of us. And with us in this fight every step of the way is
my friend Beto O’Rourke.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220628-2.xdDN7U&refcode=ema20220628-196049&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=196049%2E444211%2EfbzHX1 ]Repro rights rally in Austin

Take a look at that photo. What you’re looking at is thousands of Texans
coming together to rally for our reproductive freedom. Beto’s campaign put
that event in the Texas Capital together in a matter of hours. And as a
lifelong Texan, this image fills me with a lot of hope.

Change is coming to Texas. Beto understands that action is the
antidote to despair, and the key to victory. He is inspiring unmistakable
grassroots energy in every part of our state, and building a coalition of
millions of Texas voters who reject Greg Abbott’s extreme decision to
strip us of our fundamental rights.

Make no mistake, we are up against massive political power in this fight.
So if we are going to restore reproductive freedom in Texas, we must seize
political power on our own — beginning by electing a governor who believes
in a woman’s freedom to make her own decisions about her own body, health
care, and future.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220628-2.xdDN7U&refcode=ema20220628-196049&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=196049%2E444211%2EfbzHX1 ]We need you with us.
Before the critical June 30th campaign fundraising deadline in Texas, I’m
asking you to pitch in any amount you can to help us defeat Greg Abbott
and elect Beto.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220628-2.xdDN7U&refcode=ema20220628-196049&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=196049%2E444211%2EfbzHX1 ]Contribute $3

Just like the Texas women who took their fight all the way to the Supreme
Court in 1973, I believe we will come together and do whatever it takes to
reclaim what is rightfully ours: the ability to make decisions about our
own bodies.

We are the ones to meet this moment. It is on all of us to do our part.

In solidarity,

Cecile

Cecile Richards
National Finance Chair, Beto for Texas
Former President of Planned Parenthood

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/bft-unsubscribe/?t=1022&akid=196049%2E444211%2EfbzHX1

body:
Unity Now for Colorado's Future

http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049

The Greg Lopez for Governor campaign could never have made it this far without the hard work, dedication, and support you've each made for this campaign.

Since August 2019, Greg has traveled to all four corners of Colorado and back again sharing his message and listening to Coloradans in all 64 counties from all walks of life working in all industries from all political parties.

Their shared sentiment is that they're done with Jared Polis.

Tonight, the voters decided this is unequivocally true but with Heidi Ganahl (https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049) as their champion and standard-bearer. I respect, honor, and support their decision unreservedly.

** Please Join Me in Congratulating and Supporting
------------------------------------------------------------

** Heidi Ganahl for Governor
------------------------------------------------------------

** This Fight Begins NOW!
------------------------------------------------------------

There are many things you can do right now to support Heidi and her campaign to defeat Jared Polis in November and save Colorado:
* Learn about Heidi Ganahl and her Campaign (https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/about/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049)
* Listen to / Read about Her Priorities (https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/fighting-for-colorado/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049)
* See Who's Endorsed Heidi Ganahl (https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/endorsements/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049)
* Endorse Heidi Yourself (https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/endorse/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049)
* Sign up to be Her Volunteer and Take Action (https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/action/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049)
* Purchase Heidi Ganahl Merchandise to Show Your Support (https://secure.winred.com/heidi-for-governor/storefront/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049)

...and most importantly...
Donate to Heidi (https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/donate/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049)

Now is the time for all of us to unite behind the movement that not only will reverse the disastrous policies, regulations, and executive orders that destroyed over 600,000 small businesses and the way of life for hundreds of thousands of Coloradans, but to elect a Governor who would never have been so destructive and disconnected from the people in the first place.

For months, I've supported and spoken the message of Putting People Over Politics.

Today, I back those words up with the integrity of my actions. The people have chosen Heidi Ganahl (https://www.heidiforgovernor.com/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049) and so do I.

Most Respectfully,
C. J. Garbo, Campaign Manager
Greg Lopez for Governor

============================================================
** One of us for all of us (http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=fa9bdc4ece-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_09_17&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-fa9bdc4ece-584862049)
We are Coloradans who want to freely and responsibly live our best lives. We refuse to be told by so-called experts and politicians how we must live. Together, we can flip the power back to the people by electing a new governor that’s one of us, for all of us. Independence Day Celebration

The 56th annual Independence Day parade will be celebrated this year on July 4.

Independence Day Parade

The parade steps off at 10 a.m. at 4100 Chain Bridge Road, rain or shine. The parade loops around Old Town Fairfax, along Chain Bridge Road, Main Street, University Drive, and Armstrong Street. Among the entries in this year’s parade are nine high school marching bands, large inflatable parade

balloons, floats, and clowns.

Visit the parade page for the parade video, the event highlights video, and photos from the event.<https://www.fairfaxva.gov/government/parks-recreation/special-events/independence-day-celebration/parade>

We are looking for Volunteers to come out at 7:30am to distribute

materials and march with Karina in the parade. We will have t-shirts for you and it will be a fabulous event

Please email volunteer@KarinaForCongress.com or text 703-577-2410 to sign up.

Celebrate Independence Day with the conservative movement!

The Soirée is held at Occoquan Regional Park located conveniently just 30 minutes southwest of Washington D.C. in Lorton, Virginia. The event runs from 11:00 am to 3:00 pm on July 4. Admission is free for all thanks to the generosity of the sponsoring organizations.

Each year nearly 1,000 locals enjoy a featured keynote speaker, a bluegrass band playing throughout the day, and a free beer and wine garden. Delicious barbeque is provided along with drinks, snacks, ice cream, and fun for the kids.

This year features Nicolee Ambrose as the keynote speaker!

name: Lauren Daugherty
subject: Political lines drawn - Fed vs. the states
body:
The state-level is where we see the most pushback against federal tyranny.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze6pan5me0b4rh26gj28rodqg1t3lvq8t1uh17g0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uirbac36eao64ddgmermbdbmeljmccpieupn7cb26co6edplm6rrdd1kmhhb2dtnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhm2qr4o3ncpj3co5jcdjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5cdgm9or0s9hm49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp2hka5gst713la5bucd65qkf6b9lebg21u42790_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5ie6o72cdh2bs)

Hello Friend,

What a wild ride the last two years have been.

President Biden's policies have:
* Run inflation up to a 40-year high.
* Crushed small businesses with mandates.
* Torn families apart with ridiculous health policies.
* Left a generation of children behind in school.

We CAN NOT take another two more years of this incompetence.

**The state-level is where we see the most pushback against federal tyranny. **

The states are fighting back--and _Operation Win at the Door (OWD)_ is a big part of the fight.

Operation Win at the Door's mission is to build a bench of 250 liberty legislators across the country by the end of 2022.

We're close to meeting our goal of growing our coalition of state reps to 250.

Friend, there is still a major threat to our liberties.

[_**The federal government is fighting to increase its power every day. Can you help us fight for our liberties? Click here to donate $20.22, $50, $100, or any amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znb6th6ba4lqppke58cupc1o3u5fka14vfgm7nn0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5ie6o72cdh2bs)

Here's how OWD works.

We train thousands of college students and young adults at our conferences throughout the year. There, they learn the basics of activism and political advocacy.

We then recruit and refer hundreds of trained activists to the fight for liberty. These activists deploy to key districts around the country to support hardcore liberty legislators. They go on to knock on doors, make phone calls, and do the hard work to help elect liberty-minded candidates.

_**And, Friend, this works.**_

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zihtiedtfsk8fagv92h24bhb695qo1h1ii84mtho_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5ie6o72cdh2bs)

During the 2020 elections, OWD activists:
* Contributed to 123 Wins
* Total Doors: 1.5 million
* Total Calls: 2,288,269
* Total ID Texts: 75,428
* Total Mailers: 540,976
* 72 wins in Counties Biden carried

**So far, we have a coalition of 218 hardcore liberty legislators located in 37 states.**

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2k5c06en0fg4hlicil13com2obuuo3acvsbln2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5ie6o72cdh2bs)

During the Covid pandemic, we saw an unprecedented threat to our liberties.

Families weren't allowed to hug each other.

Children were forced to wear masks in schools.

Churches were closed down because they were "non-essential."

But OWD activists wouldn't stand for it.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj0nu68auabs3727cpv5248p4lngkv7f1iatp0r8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c5ie6o72cdh2bs)

**The legislators in our coalition and OWD activists bring about real change to everyday life.**

We've helped pass Constitutional Carry in seven states.

We've defended freedom of speech on the campuses of 1.57 million college students every year.

And we've defeated unconstitutional COVID mandates.

Friend, do NOT write off 2022 as an easy "red wave".

The key will always be state elections and making sure there are enough well-trained boots-on-the-ground activists available to help elect pro-liberty legislators.

Can you support these pro-liberty legislators and activists? **Click any button below to donate. **

name: Phil Wood
subject: 🔴🔵Not a win 🔵🔴
body:
Dear Friends,

Thank you for all your prayers, encouragement, and support during the past
several months.

While the vote yesterday did not turn out in my favor, I am blessed by God
and encouraged that He is in control. We are blessed with a great country
and this is a great week to celebrate it.

WE worked hard, with so many people helping in so many ways.

I feel the voice of the innocent, unborn child was elevated, and we
rejoice with the reversal of Roe v. Wade.

The winner of the Primary in the 8th was Chris Dargis. He seems like an
upstanding man and I pray for his success.

Blessings on you as you serve the Lord each day in the very special way He
has planned for you!

Phil

The winner of the Primary in the 8th was Chris Dargis. He seems like an upstanding man and I pray for his success. Blessings on you as you serve the Lord each day in the very special way He has planned for you! Phil

Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zq9jvusojr25up0vo4mpamkd51rqtr6230e667o8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clg64oj4c3h2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6271emadan16mocmd0nj9p1rmj3l306drk4csc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clg64oj4c3h2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

name: Morton Blackwell
subject: Urgent scholarship request for young conservatives
body:
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the L
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfi35a9pge21856ubn98jt0dj9gbaktmcq6gbg40_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clg62o32clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqedtge1p7adjkm4qj7cbkmgor79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onmm4pjatpkmhjb8oji6aom0orjcsq78spkmjhb9pjjc1h64c33mhg6acjlm5h31puie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74dj666rj6oj7mph6ccdgm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zhgcbn76s21ehpe9q4s0tkvlttn8arr1r3e4evoo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clg62o32clh2bs) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [**Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmhvnf3qrurr7ln7lj1r13akpadf9dc7t0jougm0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clg62o32clh2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbuh4goc4jgen8apsk3of0n07mvvfok133hm5mto_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clg62o32clh2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute
---
| | The Leadership Institute 1101 N. Highland St. Steven P.J. Wood Building Arlington VA 22201 United States
---

body:
| | | |
---
**Fellow Patriot...**

I have had the honor and privilege of being asked to serve on the Board of Directors for a new organization called the Team Awesomism Virtual Academy LLC.
This is an organization, founded by Peyton White, who is an autistic adult and has a heart to help other autistic adults.

Based in Conroe, TX, the organization’s cofounder is Peyton’s mom, Lynne White.

The mission of the Team Awesomism Virtual Academy is to help autistic adults be part of (and grow in) a community, learn and refresh soft skills, life skills, and social skills.

If you or someone you know has a heart for the autistic community, I’d like to invite you to attend a sneak peek at what the virtual academy is about and to really share the vision.

**Here are the details:** Team Awesomism is inviting you to a scheduled Zoom meeting.

**Topic:** Closer Look at Virtual Academy

**Time:** Jun 30, 2022 01:00 PM Central Time (US and Canada)

**Join Zoom Meeting:**[https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84073262550?pwd=aEo2ZEpvK1NrekxEMWlmcmFHOWNzZz09](https://jamesonellis.lt.acemlna.com/Prod/link-tracker?redirectUrl=aHR0cHMlM0ElMkYlMkZ1czAyd2ViLnpvb20udXMlMkZqJTJGODQwNzMyNjI1NTAlM0Zwd2QlM0RhRW8yWkVwdksxTnJla3hFTVdsbWNtRkhPV056WnowOQ==&sig=EhMG9VjKgGaRycgxuyBGTx2LsLH4kNghAuauC4LWbvQv&iat=1656509434&a=%7C%7C611311006%7C%7C&account=jamesonellis%2Eactivehosted%2Ecom&email=8RRDsQMegL%2Bk1g7KlTCN33wFoqDlMHNmyq65fGLdufk%3D&s=cabcbe31a720242486b887158a77876f&i=75A91A1A500)

Hoover Institution Senior Fellow **Thomas Sowell takes an empirical approach** in his commentary, [**_"_****_Trickle Down " Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich._****_"_**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60405997:Wk0f5AhWN:m:1:2532013465:2ABE4DEA7F5A88048732E9A15B62066F:r)

As a friend and supporter of the Hoover Institution, we are proud to offer you this valuable, thought-provoking resource free of charge.

FROM MY SENATE DESK

Things are really heating up here in Raleigh. The short session is expected to end in the coming weeks, and I've been overwhelmingly busy working on legislation to help small businesses and our community before the clock strikes zero.

Following is a quick highlight of some of the current goings-on from Raleigh.

To get legislative news closer to the time it's happening, be sure to follow me on [Facebook](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FKedfofhb9WeEI5K6cqMZXQgLmPdf1Q89VYtLS_1Lh4TZ-llbj1AjgNUwRbgeUPeotte1087AoFgwU-ScmLtJc819DLYc6z0bvmry7ayw3MxkliTWHL4JRpNIWCkQLaoxCkoHQ_jP35-onqbnCfZZLAPHvoqXN9xu1C4-cgYmsc=&c=670CZ0JOoBVdBBgM1LudsofnbGWtv0Y_OpZz0Knp2Ke8q2u_TjKXoA==&ch=a-jZG5Le63lJ5aa_oVoDvfZja1h71GbRnnPFiePyhwfzqPUyrYixWg==) or frequently visit my [website](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FKedfofhb9WeEI5K6cqMZXQgLmPdf1Q89VYtLS_1Lh4TZ-llbj1Aji1uDWBaZGbDXhLcbEZxmLiWN4zSRu2LLTr9r5e6DxTP-rrFoAcF1yAGa45jLMLgx54GC2YBDPTLCEu_KTp89II=&c=670CZ0JOoBVdBBgM1LudsofnbGWtv0Y_OpZz0Knp2Ke8q2u_TjKXoA==&ch=a-jZG5Le63lJ5aa_oVoDvfZja1h71GbRnnPFiePyhwfzqPUyrYixWg==).

---
| Public Support: The Parents' Bill of Rights
---
| | |
---|---
|
We must bring decisions made about a child's education closer to the parents. That is why I continue to support the Parents' Bill of Rights.

Earlier this month, along party lines, Senate Republicans passed the Parents' Bill of Rights. Since then, support has continued to grow for the bill - which seeks to keep age-inappropriate material out of the classroom curriculum of our youngest students.

To me, this bill is a no-brainer. 8-year-olds should not be learning about sexual orientation in their 3rd-grade classroom before parents have even had a chance to comfortably discuss it with them at home. Gender identity and sexual orientation introductions should be happening in the home, not in public school buildings; and a recent [WRAL/SurveyUSA poll](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FKedfofhb9WeEI5K6cqMZXQgLmPdf1Q89VYtLS_1Lh4TZ-llbj1AjsYx-FJL87-3d1DwNrGUfxahtFAAJ9N94iet8jxWJzL4MQCFq4YvIMnuCIa7c2TM-XWhzsa-Zv3CUq3pW055wxNC4PTWIxc4coXFegquh0cwdzGxi6WCdvbOTN-HKnT3r_iHTKMKI3ewm08FBAfcqJPAwRWZ1Bvv6d5iP5havdlz0T1arRUSykM=&c=670CZ0JOoBVdBBgM1LudsofnbGWtv0Y_OpZz0Knp2Ke8q2u_TjKXoA==&ch=a-jZG5Le63lJ5aa_oVoDvfZja1h71GbRnnPFiePyhwfzqPUyrYixWg==) shows the majority of NC citizens agree.

WRAL's poll indicates overarching support for a legislative ban on the teaching of sexual orientation or gender identity in kindergarten through third-grade classrooms. 58% of all North Carolina adults support this ban, which includes both Democrat and Unaffiliated voters. Why? Because it just makes sense. This poll affirms that the people of North Carolina understand we should be teaching our children how to read chapter books and do long division rather than trying to prematurely discuss a child's sexual preference amongst their peers.

Right now, the Parent's Bill of Rights is waiting to be passed by the NC House before it becomes law; but in the meantime, I am proud to be a part of the much-needed movement to protect our children and their parents' rights in North Carolina.
| | |
---
| NC Democrats Try to Jeopardize Election Integrity... Again
---
| | |
---|---
|
North Carolinians have lost faith in our democratic process and I don't blame them. Bills like SB 916, [Safeguard Fair Elections Act](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FKedfofhb9WeEI5K6cqMZXQgLmPdf1Q89VYtLS_1Lh4TZ-llbj1AjsYx-FJL87-3mLdJTVrEiYUzGAeOyWPy9BjAOjhbgifmrr4up4cios8Om7uRKCnh-nFzbLyYLG63g9ZuEDB2hDctC-GSLy1VFovA66uoSNrUMaXCJmF_ylYHZOtSG9FkXp3xp_hX0I7UqD_UDAbcU6eJsDAR9pEmmw==&c=670CZ0JOoBVdBBgM1LudsofnbGWtv0Y_OpZz0Knp2Ke8q2u_TjKXoA==&ch=a-jZG5Le63lJ5aa_oVoDvfZja1h71GbRnnPFiePyhwfzqPUyrYixWg==), proposed by NC Democrats make a mockery of the concerns shared by thousands across the state.

The bill falsely portrays itself as a 'safeguard' against voter intimidation, threats, or coercion; but really, these segments of the bill act as a distraction from the bill's intentions to discretely strip away and severely limit the right to comprehensively audit election results, which is the only way to truly certify an election that is being challenged.

Post-election audits are used to ensure votes are both recorded and tallied accurately. They serve to protect elections from potential fraud or violations of election law and against foreign interference. These audits are critical in restoring public confidence in elections and confirming that no false ballots have been cast and no voting machines have been tampered with.

But NC Dems don't seem to care about verifying that no tampering has occurred in an election, as their bill limits Third-Party Forensic Audits and in turn, proposes risk-limiting audits that are explicitly prohibited from influencing the result of an election. Make it make sense. Let's restrict current auditing methods and then provide a new one that has absolutely no potential remedy if fraud or tampering were to be detected? The bill is tainted with restrictive wordsmithing that seeks to limit recourse for the flagrant violation of election laws.

Every citizen should be able to feel confident in the system we use to elect their representatives. Instead, Democrats are working against the grain to restrict election transparency and reduce voter confidence. I refuse to sit back and allow them to continue to chip away at our democracy's bedrock. We must truly secure our elections and prevent them from future malicious manipulation.
| | |
---
| Update: NC Voter ID Court Case
---
| | |
---|---
|
For years, the NC Legislature has been fighting to implement Voter ID in accordance with the will of the people after an amendment was passed on the ballot in 2018. One of those battles grew between lawmakers and North Carolina's Democratic Attorney General, Josh Stein, who refused to adequately defend SB 824, the bill introduced and passed in the legislature detailing Voter ID requirements.

In Berger v. NC NAACP, the General Assembly was not named as a defendant in court. We had to ask the trial court for permission to intervene and for months, the lower federal courts have kept us from participating by rejecting our attempts to "intervene" in the case. We have continued to appeal that decision and we finally got the first win in our fight for Voter ID!

Yesterday, the United States Supreme Court ruled in favor of the legislature, granting us standing to intervene and defend the laws of North Carolina. We will now be able to participate in the Federal Voter ID case, which was "stayed" pending the resolution of the US Supreme Court appeal.

This decision will rightfully grant us the power to defend the will of the people and represent our Voter ID law in all remaining Voter ID cases, including Berger v. NC NAACP, Holmes et. al. v. Moore et. al., and NAACP v. Moore.

Voter ID laws should have been implemented when it first passed in 2018,. and now the legislature can see it through to ensure it does get implemented at the conclusion of these legal challenges.

I am thrilled that this decision has been made in our favor and that we can continue to fight for election integrity, even when the NC Attorney General will not. I believe that this is a step in the right direction and am excited that the voices of North Carolinians in support of Voter ID can finally be heard.
| | |
---
| Chiefs of Police Visit NC General Assembly
---
| | |
---|---
|
This past Wednesday I had the honor of welcoming Chiefs of Police from across the State of North Carolina to the General Assembly. The NC Association of Chiefs of Police were visiting to share their legislative priorities and show their support for all we've done to back law enforcement over the past few years.

I had the specific pleasure of speaking with two Chiefs of Police from my backyard, Chris Beddingfield of Biltmore Forest and Blair Myhand of Hendersonville. We discussed current policies moving through the General Assembly such as the Compassionate Care Act and the legalization of marijuana; and I got to hear firsthand how the legislation can be expected to benefit or harm law enforcement's duty to keep our communities safe.

I always enjoy my time meeting with the brave men and women who protect and serve our communities. Thank you Chris and Blair for stopping by. I look forward to talking with you both again soon.

Make it make sense. Let's restrict current auditing methods and then provide a new one that has absolutely no potential remedy if fraud or tampering were to be detected? The bill is tainted with restrictive wordsmithing that seeks to limit recourse for the flagrant violation of election laws. Every citizen should be able to feel confident in the system we use to elect their representatives. Instead, Democrats are working against the grain to restrict election transparency and reduce voter confidence. I refuse to sit back and allow them to continue to chip away at our democracy's bedrock. We must truly secure our elections and prevent them from future malicious manipulation. | | | | Update: NC Voter ID Court Case | | | ---|--- | For years, the NC Legislature has been fighting to implement Voter ID in accordance with the will of the people after an amendment was passed on the ballot in 2018. One of those battles grew between lawmakers and North Carolina's Democratic Attorney General, Josh Stein, who refused to adequately defend SB 824, the bill introduced and passed in the legislature detailing Voter ID requirements. In Berger v. NC NAACP, the General Assembly was not named as a defendant in court. We had to ask the trial court for permission to intervene and for months, the lower federal courts have kept us from participating by rejecting our attempts to "intervene" in the case. We have continued to appeal that decision and we finally got the first win in our fight for Voter ID! Yesterday, the United States Supreme Court ruled in favor of the legislature, granting us standing to intervene and defend the laws of North Carolina. We will now be able to participate in the Federal Voter ID case, which was "stayed" pending the resolution of the US Supreme Court appeal. This decision will rightfully grant us the power to defend the will of the people and represent our Voter ID law in all remaining Voter ID cases, including Berger v. NC NAACP, Holmes et. al. v. Moore et. al., and NAACP v. Moore. Voter ID laws should have been implemented when it first passed in 2018,. and now the legislature can see it through to ensure it does get implemented at the conclusion of these legal challenges. I am thrilled that this decision has been made in our favor and that we can continue to fight for election integrity, even when the NC Attorney General will not. I believe that this is a step in the right direction and am excited that the voices of North Carolinians in support of Voter ID can finally be heard. | | | | Chiefs of Police Visit NC General Assembly | | | ---|--- | This past Wednesday I had the honor of welcoming Chiefs of Police from across the State of North Carolina to the General Assembly. The NC Association of Chiefs of Police were visiting to share their legislative priorities and show their support for all we've done to back law enforcement over the past few years. I had the specific pleasure of speaking with two Chiefs of Police from my backyard, Chris Beddingfield of Biltmore Forest and Blair Myhand of Hendersonville. We discussed current policies moving through the General Assembly such as the Compassionate Care Act and the legalization of marijuana; and I got to hear firsthand how the legislation can be expected to benefit or harm law enforcement's duty to keep our communities safe. I always enjoy my time meeting with the brave men and women who protect and serve our communities. Thank you Chris and Blair for stopping by. I look forward to talking with you both again soon. | | | | | Follow me on Facebook & Twitter and visit my == for the most current legislative updates | == == == == | | | Sen. Friend, I’d like to share with you the story of the NDRC: How we got our start, what we’ve accomplished so far, and all that we still have left to do in order to defend our democracy.

**It’s an incredible story that supporters like you should be proud of –[ _but if you don’t have time to read it and you’d rather just make a donation to support the NDRC’s mission, you can do so here._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47133230/353192762/1746263042?amount=20&refcode=20220624.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliY2I1M2U3LWIzZjctZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lJLSOqJ39j2Qa40Yn3mHH8-2i2CCVvIE2nBCigpWTo0=)**

In 2011, Republicans manipulated the maps – and even though Democrats won the 2012 congressional popular vote by 1.4 million votes, the GOP won 33 more seats in the U.S. House. This was fundamentally unfair, and we could see that gerrymandering was obstructing the progressive legislation desired by the majority of Americans. Clearly, something had to be done.

So, in 2017, we launched the NDRC. And from the beginning, we made a big impact with targeted investments to help elect Democrats who would fight for fair maps. On Election Day 2018, fair-map candidates won at the ballot box, along with redistricting reforms that Republicans are _still_ fighting to this day.
[PITCH IN TO HELP US KEEP MAKING A DIFFERENCE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47133233/353192765/1746263042?amount=20&refcode=20220624.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliY2I1M2U3LWIzZjctZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lJLSOqJ39j2Qa40Yn3mHH8-2i2CCVvIE2nBCigpWTo0=)

In 2019 and 2020, we continued to support fair-map candidates while also defending the freedom to vote amidst a coordinated GOP push to pass voter suppression laws that targeted communities of color and hurt all voters. And when the redistricting cycle began again in 2021, we placed the spotlight on map manipulation and mobilized activists against GOP gerrymandering all over the country.

Thanks to our work, the maps that are in place are far more fair than they would have been if Republicans had been allowed to gerrymander unchecked. But even now, there are court cases pending and elections coming up that will have a big impact on the maps of the future and the gains we’ve already made. So the fight isn’t over – we have a lot more to do and **we can’t afford to get complacent.**

Since our launch, the NDRC has been successful thanks to the generous support of [_grassroots donors like you._](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47133234/353192766/1746263042?amount=20&refcode=20220624.1r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjliY2I1M2U3LWIzZjctZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lJLSOqJ39j2Qa40Yn3mHH8-2i2CCVvIE2nBCigpWTo0=) That hasn’t changed. We want to acknowledge that the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade is hitting many people hard. This decision will cause tremendous harm. If you would like to support abortion access directly, you can make a donation to more than 80 abortion funds at = Friend, I’d like to share with you the story of the NDRC: How we got our start, what we’ve accomplished so far, and all that we still have left to do in order to defend our democracy. It’s an incredible story that supporters like you should be proud of –= = = In 2011, Republicans manipulated the maps – and even though Democrats won the 2012 congressional popular vote by 1.4 million votes, the GOP won 33 more seats in the U.S. House. This was fundamentally unfair, and we could see that gerrymandering was obstructing the progressive legislation desired by the majority of Americans. Clearly, something had to be done. So, in 2017, we launched the NDRC. And from the beginning, we made a big impact with targeted investments to help elect Democrats who would fight for fair maps. On Election Day 2018, fair-map candidates won at the ballot box, along with redistricting reforms that Republicans are still fighting to this day. = In 2019 and 2020, we continued to support fair-map candidates while also defending the freedom to vote amidst a coordinated GOP push to pass voter suppression laws that targeted communities of color and hurt all voters. And when the redistricting cycle began again in 2021, we placed the spotlight on map manipulation and mobilized activists against GOP gerrymandering all over the country. Thanks to our work, the maps that are in place are far more fair than they would have been if Republicans had been allowed to gerrymander unchecked. But even now, there are court cases pending and elections coming up that will have a big impact on the maps of the future and the gains we’ve already made. Peter,

We did it!

I am so grateful to everyone who came out to vote yesterday -- and I want to say a huge thank you to all the people who called, sent texts, knocked doors, donated, and showed up to make this win possible.

We couldn't have done this without you -- and we need you even more for what's ahead.

Kevin Stitt has already spent millions of dollars in this race, and we can be sure he's going to spend millions more to try and hold on to power.

We're also facing a political landscape with lots of people who think that Democrats don't stand a chance in Oklahoma.

But we know better.

The Oklahomans I've spoken with can see that extremism and partisanship aren't going to solve the problems they're facing. They're looking for common sense solutions, and ready to meet on common ground.

subject: We need a game plan

www.davidtrone.com [www.davidtrone.com]
Peter,
There’s no other way to say it: the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade is dangerous . Not only for the millions of women who will undoubtedly lose their right to reproductive freedom, but for the concerning precedent this sets for other important points of progress we’ve made over the years.
The Republicans in power haven’t minced words. They’re coming for marriage equality next. And access to contraception. And criminal punishment for same-sex couples. And more restrictions on the right to vote. If you think this doesn’t impact you, you’re wrong. It will fundamentally alter the very foundations of our democracy. All of us should be concerned. If we take them at their word, it’s clear they won’t stop until they’ve torn down every victory we’ve had for decades — and they’ll do it all in the name of “freedom.”
Now more than ever before, we need a game plan and a full-throttled attack. Words aren’t enough. We need to mobilize and take action. Here’s my three-step plan to begin our response to this despicable decision.
Step 1: Call on the people in power. Congress must codify Roe v. Wade immediately to protect the millions of women whose states will ban abortion (or have already). We’ve already passed the Women’s Health Protection Act to enshrine these protections in the House – and I proudly stand by my 100% pro-choice record. I encourage you to call your Senators and encourage them to get on board as well. Thankfully, Marylanders have allies in Senators Cardin and Van Hollen, but other states aren’t so lucky.
Step 2: Mobilize to elect those who will protect reproductive rights and stand up against those who won’t. No matter how hard we try to codify Roe now, it’s unlikely to get through the Senate. So we need to vote out everyone who stands in our way. In my race for Congress in a newly-drawn, highly competitive district, I’m up against a conservative fanatic who is celebrating the loss of reproductive freedom for women. Over the coming months, I’ll be working every day to keep him out of Washington, and partnering with campaigns up and down the ballot while I do it.
Endorsements of my campaign by the Planned Parenthood Action Fund and NARAL Pro-Choice Maryland will provide critical support, but I need your help, too. Click here to volunteer on my campaign. Every hour helps. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/cU3fb9_wjESGnsSAWdxt1Q2]
Step 3: Donate to organizations working to provide critical reproductive healthcare to women. Over the past few days, I’m sure you’ve heard from countless politicians asking for your money. While I appreciate the support I’ve received from so many, right now it’s better spent directly supporting the organizations doing good throughout our community. Peter,

Tomorrow marks the final end-of-quarter FEC deadline before our August primary. Here’s why it’s critical that we hit our goal by then:
1. Ron Johnson is expected to bring in **_millions_** of dollars from his corporate interest buddies. We can’t let that go unmatched.
2. This public filing deadline is our last chance to show that we have what it takes to beat Ron Johnson. Last quarter, we were the only candidate that came close to matching what Johnson brought in, and we have to do it again.

clean_body: Here’s what you need to know about my official GOP opponent... | = = Team, it’s official: Joe O’Dea is my official Republican opponent in the general election. Here’s what you need to know about Joe O’Dea: He was endorsed by the Colorado NRA and opposes new gun safety legislation that would keep Coloradans safe, He came out against Colorado’s law guaranteeing the right to choose, And he suggested cutting funding for critical safety nets like Social Security and Medicare. There’s a saying: When someone shows you who they are, believe them the first time. We know who Joe O’Dea is. He’s given his own campaign seven-figures so he could buy his way onto the ballot, then he dumped more cash into attack ads to try and win this seat. He’s out of step with Coloradans, and he’ll be a rubber stamp for Rick Scott — who wants to raise taxes for low-income folks and seniors — and Mitch McConnell. So, please make a founding donation to the Bennet Defense Fund before tomorrow's first end-of-quarter deadline of the general election **to help defend my seat and continue defending our fundamental freedoms. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | ****=** | **=** | | **=** | **=** | | **=** | **=** When it comes to the issues Coloradans care about — like creating jobs, lowering costs, protecting our communities from climate change, and investing in working families — my record stands tall. The Republican National Committee recently dropped organizers and operatives in Colorado, and Mitch McConnell and the National GOP have raised over $200 million to target races like mine. Now that O’Dea is the official Republican nominee, their efforts will only ramp up. subject: Turning despair into action

body:

Hi Peter,
Last week, most of my constituents – many of you – could get to an abortion clinic within 10 miles. Today, it’s 600 miles to Kansas, 750 miles to New Mexico, or 300 miles to Monterrey, Mexico. It's unacceptable, and here are SEVEN things we are doing about it, together.
1. Supporting national groups who can legally help Texans travel out of state for care. You can make a contribution to the National Abortion Federation here. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/roe-support-abortion-access-tx?refcode=06.28_gregcasar_email]
2. Pushing District Attorneys across the state to NOT prosecute Texans for abortion cases. If the DAs of the 30 biggest counties refuse to prosecute, we help support 23 million Texans. You can send a message to Texas DAs here. [https://actionnetwork.org/petitions/tell-texas-das-to-not-prosecute-abortion-cases]
3. Exploring every option to get abortion access to Texans, on the edge of state lines and within state lines. We are all asking the Biden Administration to use every avenue possible to provide abortion medication and abortion care using the federal government's authority above state government.
4. Pushing for the end to the filibuster and the codification of abortion rights with the Women's Health Protection Act. I’m coordinating with my future Congressional colleagues to see what paths we can take to pass these measures through the Senate.
5. Supporting expansion of the Supreme Court so that it is rebalanced with justices who want to protect our rights, not take them away. Rep. Mondaire Jones’s bill to expand the Supreme Court would help restore balance and legitimacy to the court.
6. Campaigning for Beto O'Rourke for Governor, Mike Collier for Attorney General, and Rochelle Garza for Attorney General of Texas. We can stop state prosecutions of Texas' draconian anti-abortion laws and begin to take care of Texas famillies, rather than targeting them.
7. Organizing our neighborhoods and communities in Texas to make transformative change in this moment of crisis. Roe v. Wade was created 50 years ago IN TEXAS, when Sarah Weddington sued Dallas District Attorney Henry Wade over Texas' abortion ban. Texas brought our country abortion rights, and it’s Texans who are going to bring them back.
Yours,
- Greg
Greg Casar
Democratic Nominee
Texas Congressional District 35

clean_body: [] Hi Peter, Last week, most of my constituents – many of you – could get to an abortion clinic within 10 miles. Today, it’s 600 miles to Kansas, 750 miles to New Mexico, or 300 miles to Monterrey, Mexico. It's unacceptable, and here are SEVEN things we are doing about it, together. 1. Supporting national groups who can legally help Texans travel out of state for care. You can make a contribution to the National Abortion Federation here. [] 2. Pushing District Attorneys across the state to NOT prosecute Texans for abortion cases. If the DAs of the 30 biggest counties refuse to prosecute, we help support 23 million Texans. You can send a message to Texas DAs here. [] 3. Exploring every option to get abortion access to Texans, on the edge of state lines and within state lines. We are all asking the Biden Administration to use every avenue possible to provide abortion medication and abortion care using the federal government's authority above state government. 4. Pushing for the end to the filibuster and the codification of abortion rights with the Women's Health Protection Act. I’m coordinating with my future Congressional colleagues to see what paths we can take to pass these measures through the Senate. 5. Supporting expansion of the Supreme Court so that it is rebalanced with justices who want to protect our rights, not take them away. Rep. Mondaire Jones’s bill to expand the Supreme Court would help restore balance and legitimacy to the court. 6. Campaigning for Beto O'Rourke for Governor, Mike Collier for Attorney General, and Rochelle Garza for Attorney General of Texas. We can stop state prosecutions of Texas' draconian anti-abortion laws and begin to take care of Texas famillies, rather than targeting them. 7. Organizing our neighborhoods and communities in Texas to make transformative change in this moment of crisis. Roe v. Wade was created 50 years ago IN TEXAS, when Sarah Weddington sued Dallas District Attorney Henry Wade over Texas' abortion ban. Texas brought our country abortion rights, and it’s Texans who are going to bring them back. body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6106%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=l8YQMTegxlRg2y%2fu2TCeoQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63162%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TX1AHbWpjH4qW9Gcer21aw&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well.
Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** --not adequate for the challenges of our time.
How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges?
Well, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_.
Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution.
Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.”
That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves.
**So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
_**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more.
The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63163%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sDQrYNqYCw4vSTd%2bHxxfQg&sysid=1) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long.
Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63164%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=BdyQKXRpxH5geyP398XeQA&sysid=1)
Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

My friend Fred Guttenberg lost his daughter in the Parkland shooting.

Within hours of the shooting, I was on the scene. Within days, I worked with him and other Marjory Stoneman Douglas families to turn anguish into action.

We stood up to the NRA to pass gun violence prevention laws in Florida. I know we can do the same in Congress.

I’m honored that Fred told his story in our first campaign ad and humbled to have his support. Click here to watch, share, and help us bring the fight for gun violence prevention to Congress.

I’m grateful that Congress finally took some action to combat the nationwide epidemic of gun violence.

This new gun safety law is necessary but not sufficient. We need universal background checks. We need nationwide red flag laws. The minimum age to purchase a gun nationwide needs to be 21. And we must ban assault weapons.

I’m ready to bring the fight to Congress with the support of Fred Guttenberg and people like you who care about our kids, our safety, and our future.

Friends, help us continue the fight. Click here to watch and share our latest ad today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jm-email-eoqjune]

Thanks,

Jared

Jevin was just named a DCCC Red to Blue race, making it one of this year’s top pick-up opportunities for Democrats. Flipping this seat is essential to maintaining our House majority next year. I fully believe Jevin is the only candidate who can flip this seat blue. = | = Jevin’s been a steadfast advocate for our Arizona communities. When he is elected, I know together we will continue to push for more access to healthcare, protect and expand voting rights, and address the urgent crisis of income inequality. We need Jevin’s voice in Congress. This movement relies on the power of grassroots supporters like you. = | | | = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you, Ruben Gallego Congressman, Arizona’s 7th Congressional District = * | | = Paid for by Friends of Jevin D. | Dear Friend,
We are a nation of immigrants. But, we are also a nation founded on the rule of law. That's why I think it is so terrible that the Legislature is moving rapidly to make Massachusetts a sanctuary state.
---
| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Vk7HQLmeJVHEwO9rSWj5ijGIEJEE3xVWXr8A6JscaF1of884Ei6llcUDFy4foA3cGv3Da5Q7WKaYCEh5Pkmyp2D_GwHxi6ObW-0cCsvYxl9UANqf3qQknytpJlt_7sUrsCKDM0osC5x7pX7zi62sDkje6L40iqMk&c=c5oUTO1RQuMsz9aZgCyW1JutG8kdynxxu0_tfz58mWZPYFI2ZsSGsw==&ch=I_q2AlpJPlPZOVzvtSghXmmj933s05i8SGCJ2qJLrn6mB0QTrDYb1A==)
---
---
| A few weeks ago, the Legislature passed a bill to give driver's licenses to illegal immigrants. Now, those same legislators are preparing to take a vote on the so-called Safe Communities Act, which would prevent information sharing between state and federal officials.
I asked my good friend, Maureen Maloney, to chair a campaign for a ballot question to repeal the driver's license bill. I whole-heartedly support those efforts, which are now underway. But, in order to get on the ballot, the group will need to collect tens of thousands of signatures from voters over the next few weeks. I need your help to make sure this question makes the ballot so we can repeal the law.
It's clear legislators are intent on making Massachusetts a sanctuary state for illegal immigrants. This is wrong on so many levels, including the fact that it is offensive to the many lawful immigrants who came to our state legally, following all the rules to become a citizen of our country. It is important for us to oppose these legislators, starting with the repeal of the driver's license bill.
Will you help collect signatures to repeal the driver's license bill? If you haven't already signed up, please provide us with your information by using the link below.
---
| [Sign Up Now!](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Vk7HQLmeJVHEwO9rSWj5ijGIEJEE3xVWXr8A6JscaF1of884Ei6llcUDFy4foA3cGv3Da5Q7WKaYCEh5Pkmyp2D_GwHxi6ObW-0cCsvYxl9UANqf3qQknytpJlt_7sUrsCKDM0osC5x7pX7zi62sDkje6L40iqMk&c=c5oUTO1RQuMsz9aZgCyW1JutG8kdynxxu0_tfz58mWZPYFI2ZsSGsw==&ch=I_q2AlpJPlPZOVzvtSghXmmj933s05i8SGCJ2qJLrn6mB0QTrDYb1A==)

| It's a big challenge, but not an insurmountable task. Just remember -- back in 2014, we collected more than 100,000 signatures from voters to tank the gas tax.
We did it before and we're going to do it again.
---
| Thanks for your support!

Team,
As we close out the end of June and continue to process the Supreme Court’s reversal of Roe V. Wade, I wanted to take a moment to take stock of where things stand in Michigan’s new 7th district.
I’ve always been a numbers person. I run my campaign with the knowledge of where we’ve been, how we got there, and what we need to do to achieve our goals. So with our end-of-quarter deadline approaching on June 30th, I thought it was a perfect time to take a look at some numbers from my last two races, and how they can inform the fight ahead.

So, with that in mind, let’s take a look at where we are today.
We have a brand-new district to compete in, meaning I’ve gone from running in 2.5 counties to running in 7 counties. That means I’m no longer running to represent some of the incredible Team Slotkin volunteers that have helped us pull off two victories in North Oakland county. It’s a huge loss, but we’re building our network in the new areas of the district. Recently, over 300 volunteers helped us collect 5,000 nominating petition signatures from all 7 counties to get my name on the ballot. And we’ve already had volunteers knock on over 4,000 doors and make over 3,000 phone calls – and it’s only June.
But those aren’t the only numbers we watch. Over $2 million has already been spent in negative digital and television ads against me this year, and a whopping $6.5 million (!) in negative television ads have been reserved for the fall. One outside group in particular, the Congressional Leadership Fund, has spent 3 times more against me already than that had at this point in 2020.
I’ve told you before that my race is the most competitive in Michigan, and one of the most competitive in the entire country – and the proof is in the numbers.
How did we succeed in the past? By securing the resources we needed to succeed well in advance. Deploying yard signs, contacting voters, combating negative ads, and assembling the largest Democratic field campaign in the Midwest takes a lot of time, and a lot of resources. Replicating our success in a brand new district that’s 1,310 square miles larger than the area I currently represent is going to require even more.
That’s why I’m asking if you will chip in before our end-of-quarter deadline on June 30th to help me compete in one of the most competitive House races in the country. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220629_1&amount=28]

I’ve told you before that my race is the most competitive in Michigan, and one of the most competitive in the entire country – and the proof is in the numbers. How did we succeed in the past? By securing the resources we needed to succeed well in advance. Deploying yard signs, contacting voters, combating negative ads, and assembling the largest Democratic field campaign in the Midwest takes a lot of time, and a lot of resources. Replicating our success in a brand new district that’s 1,310 square miles larger than the area I currently represent is going to require even more. That’s why I’m asking if you will chip in before our end-of-quarter deadline on June 30th to help me compete in one of the most competitive House races in the country. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
[Unsubscribe](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osHoET1hND)
_Please see a special message from our sponsor:_
---
[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60407184:sHoET1hND:m:1:2532013465:E97ADC04E90F4C17F90A76B32E718390:r) Dear Fellow American,
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.
A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.**
By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.
You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below:
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60407184:sHoET1hND:m:1:2532013465:E97ADC04E90F4C17F90A76B32E718390:r)**
For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.
**But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.**
This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.
Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states.
These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College.
**And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.**
So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.
**You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:**
**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60407184:sHoET1hND:m:1:2532013465:E97ADC04E90F4C17F90A76B32E718390:r)**
And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.
Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.
Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z4noda3su7khrtagtl0oe7i6usqs5v6qbmonasgo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clh6co75cdh2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zouqf3a9kkah7nbhnpa512m7qn9cf93gmloqb9gg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clh6co75cdh2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

subject: Unlock the Federalist Papers
body:
I hope you’re having a good day today.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zhrg0p2m8n4f7g62kjbbi4obhqcb3be2j372qpd8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clh62pr7cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrjcddkmiq62oplm1pjappm69i63d5hecrj4t9hecqj1djlmkqjccrge5rmbddn6v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666obbd1nmaq6ccbimmpmfc5lclp2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zigkmpgmvdhmptmq3cecgu4j9q04h3tv728tck00_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clh62pr7cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zg4u9vahrb73b85c2s55kpq8bnft2v7dig7rfvr0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clh62pr7cdh2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zrfumhd7t6r8slr7la9p86jee0jir5pcmj6k5lh0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3clh62pr7cdh2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

subject: The DOJ raided his home
body:
The left is weaponizing government power against their enemies... | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-8903415?e=17913c7d6d)
---
| | |
---
| | |
#
Friends,

I’m still shocked.

**Last week federal DOJ agents raided the home of CRA Senior Fellow Jeff Clark in the pre-dawn hours and took his electronic devices.**

Why you might ask?

Because he dared to bring up concerns about voter fraud in the 2020 election to President Trump. We knew the Biden administration and the Swamp would be bad. We knew it would be tyrannical. But it’s another level of disturbing when it’s your friend and colleague being raided and treated like a criminal simply because of his political beliefs.

Jeff [went on](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=49d28f6b75&e=17913c7d6d) _Tucker_ after the raid and said it perfectly, "_we are living in an era that I don't recognize and, increasingly, I don't recognize the country anymore with these kinds of Stasi-like things happening_."
---
|
---
| **Jeff Clark on Tucker Recounting DOJ Raiding His Home**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=5b9d383eae&e=17913c7d6d)
---

First, Jeff was a target of the January 6th committee, which is a transparent kangaroo court without any adversity designed to destroy its targets. Then, the day before his hearing, he’s the victim of a politically-motivated raid on his home. And just hours before the hearing starts the DOJ and J6 Committee leak to liberal members of the media about the raid?

**As Jeff said on Tucker, “I don’t believe in coincidences.”**

One thing is clear. This was an obvious tactic to intimidate Jeff. Jeff is a brave man, and he’s paying the price for working with President Trump to investigate voter fraud.

I [joined](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=3ce4b809ff&e=17913c7d6d) the _Charlie Kirk Show_ to explain why we need to stand up and defend Jeff from these politically-motivated attacks.
|
---
| **Russ Vought Defends Jeff Clark on Charlie Kirk Show**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=8b2d8a67e7&e=17913c7d6d)
---
As I told Charlie, Jeff was one of the few people at the Department of Justice who said voter fraud is a real problem and wanted to act on President Trump’s call to investigate it more.

Now he’s the victim of a politically-motivated attack for doing his job.

As I [said on Twitter](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=7f9c799b2d&e=17913c7d6d), this is not America. And this weaponization of government must end.
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=d4be17011f&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=e79ba3a51e&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| **It’s time for Republicans to get out of the fetal position and defend patriots like Jeff. **

If we stand up en masse and say this is unacceptable, this witch hunt will not continue.
---
| [FIGHT BACK NOW](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=70dd69c22a&e=17913c7d6d "FIGHT BACK NOW")
---
| Together we can ensure the radical left won’t mess with our elections. And we can make sure patriots like Jeff are fully supported when they speak out against government tyrants.

Thanks in advance for your support and stay tuned. I’ll continue to defend Jeff on the airwaves.

We’ll continue to keep you informed as this situation unfolds.

Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President
Center for Renewing America
