Back when we first took office, we inherited a government in distress, mismanaged by a Republican governor who was a cheerleader for Trump and actively undermining our state.
**I promised I'd be a cheerleader for our state because I love Illinois.** And today, I'm so proud of what we've achieved by putting working families first.
* We brought down the cost of health care while expanding access, and enshrined the right to abortion into state law before the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade.
* We enacted four consecutive balanced budgets and paid down debt, allowing us to fund critical services at record levels, from educating our kids to providing taxpayers with critical relief.
* We fixed thousands of roads and bridges in disrepair, upgraded railways and ports, modernized our schools, and put in place America's most ambitious climate agenda.
* We raised the minimum wage to $15 per hour and have made smart investments in technology and innovation to create jobs across the state.

But as much as this election will be won by magnifying the specific, significant progress we've delivered for your family, we also can't lose sight of the stark, serious threat represented by my opponent, Darren Bailey.
Let me be clear: **Donald Trump's handpicked candidate** — someone who sides with the insurrectionists at the Capitol, asserts that the 2020 election was stolen, and says women and their doctors should be jailed for having an abortion, even in cases of rape and incest — **doesn't deserve to come anywhere _near_ our state's highest office.**
The MAGA Republicans like Bailey want to take us backward, to make us feel alone in a struggle we're all facing together. **Amid a right-wing assault on our most fundamental rights, I'm counting on your help to keep moving Illinois forward.**

| | | **Dear Peter,**

Today’s a big day: Our pre-primary financial report is due at midnight!

**Please help us finish strong.**

Yesterday, we raised $3,760 from 25 people. AMAZING. THANK YOU!!

**Can we do it again today? **

[Any size donation helps! $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, $250 or more. Whatever you can do.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=83ed842a66&e=0faa9de128)

_Especially_ if you haven’t donated recently, please get involved. [We need everyone in.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=e016bc4856&e=0faa9de128) We need to raise _at least_ another $16,100 to fund our outreach plan and the clock is ticking!
* [Please donate](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=0a677ad2ca&e=0faa9de128)
* [Please say “Yes” to a yard sign.](mailto:contactben@bensmilowitz.com?subject=please%20deliver%20a%20lawn%20sign!&body=Hi!%20I'd%20like%20a%20lawn%20sign%20delivered.%20%20Thank%20you!!%0A%0APlease%20deliver%20the%20lawn%20sign%20to%3A%20%5BTYPE%20YOUR%20ADDRESS%20HERE%5D)
* Attend one of our three events this week in [Gaithersburg (today!), Walkersville (Friday), and Germantown (Sunday).](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=0ddfa19716&e=0faa9de128) (Can you host in your yard next week?)
* [Please get involved and volunteer: make calls or knock on doors.](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=f07b537160&e=0faa9de128)

Voters in MD-6 want a Rep focused on us, not advancing their own multi billion-dollar business. Everyone is getting bombarded with ads from my opponent and they need to know there’s a better candidate now! As a grassroots campaign, _it’s on us_ to spread the word.

Thank you for all that you’re doing. I’m so humbled to have your support.

Ben

subject: The Battle Begins Now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mann for Congress, Inc
body:
The battle to defend the lives of the unborn begins now – and it begins in Kansas. | | |
---
| |
---
| Dear Friends,

The prayers of millions of pro-life Americans were finally answered last week when the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade and returned to the American people their right to decide how abortion should be regulated in their own states. Since state governments will have to develop their own laws surrounding abortion, phase two of the battle to defend the lives of the unborn begins now – and it begins in Kansas.
_On August 2nd, when we vote on the Value Them Both amendment to our state constitution, Kansans will become the first American citizens to decide whether and to what extent their state will allow abortion services._ Going back to the 1850s when we fought to enter the Union as a free state, Kansans have always been trailblazers – especially in the face of nationwide political strife. **_I encourage everyone to vote for Value Them Both primarily to protect the lives of innocent children, but also to make sure that Kansas never becomes an abortion destination state._** Projections for these types of states are grim, I assure you. Passing Value Them Both will protect unborn babies _and_ the great state of Kansas.
I believe that life begins at conception, and I will never give up the fight to protect the lives of all Americans, born and unborn. Since taking office, I have supported more than 20 pro-life pieces of legislation and introduced legislation requiring the executive branch to notify Congress and the American public before issuing any new executive order pertaining to pro-life provisions and the right to life.
62 million Americans were robbed of their right to life in the past 50 years. Abortion was a nationwide scourge for half a century, but no more. This is a time to celebrate and thank God for answered prayers — may this ruling spark a spiritual transformation in our country.
Yours in the fight, Rep. Tracey Mann

clean_body: | | | | I still vividly remember being in the Capitol building during the insurrection on Jan 6, 2021. Our temple of democracy was defiled — windows shattered, furniture smashed, offices ransacked. We will always be in debt to our U.S. Capitol Police who proved themselves once again to be heroic defenders of the Republic on that day. Let me be clear: this was an unprecedented attack on our democracy, the likes of which we have never seen before. The House hearings on the January 6th insurrection are proving that it was worse than we feared. This was not a protest that got too "rowdy." It was a calculated and deliberate attempt to disrupt the peaceful transfer of power. Our democracy is fragile. It's clear that our slim majority in the Senate isn't enough. = = Trump and his MAGA Republican cronies were determined to take back their power by force on that day. And many of those same extremists still serve in public office. Like you, I remain absolutely horrified. But I am also more determined than ever to defend our democracy from these attacks. Because MAGA Republicans didn't go away when Trump left office. They've continued to push their lies about the 2020 election and do everything they can to cling to power. This November, nothing less than the future of our democracy is on the ballot, and it is in danger. MAGA Republicans have made it clear their intention is to turn back the clock on progress if they gain the majority. = I'm counting on you. name: Mark Kelly
subject: My decision
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
The Senate is the final defense against abortion being banned in the United States.
#

[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-june22.PHGn67&refcode=em220629-1-7&refcode2=3173.6688874.WTEBPw&t=1&akid=3173%2E6688874%2EWTEBPw)
---
Friends —
I have about 15 minutes of free time in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift.
And while I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success.
The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down.
We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money.
You know the rest... We won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.
But now we have a new mission: re-election.
And we’ve got our work cut out for us. The stakes were high before, but after this month it’s more critical than ever that we win this race. Because the Senate is now the final defense against a national abortion ban in the United States.
And in Arizona, the candidate that Trump just endorsed against me wants to go even further than the Supreme Court. He’s called for a national ban on abortion.
I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. Which is why I have to ask:
[**Can you please add a contribution to our campaign before tomorrow’s FEC deadline comes to a close at midnight? The amount you give isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. Because it all adds up when we’re all chipping in.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-june22.PHGn67&refcode=em220629-1-7&t=2&akid=3173%2E6688874%2EWTEBPw)

We're funding this campaign the right way — _together_. And with less than 48 hours to go until our critical FEC fundraising deadline, this is one of the most important days of this entire primary.

Our end of quarter deadline is TOMORROW at 11:59 PM, and we’re still not at our goal. I’m afraid we’re going to fall behind the Democrat incumbent, and we need to catch up fast. My Democrat opponent is going to use Nancy Pelosi’s network of resources to try and silence us, Peter. Hi Peter,
It’s Tom here again. In case I haven’t been able to meet yet, I’m Peter Franchot’s Finance Director.
I’ve been looking at the books ahead of our critical End-of-June deadline, and here’s my quick update: we’re making good progress towards our fundraising goal of $13,000 – but we need pick up the pace if we want to stay on track and hit our target by our June 30, 11:59 PM deadline!

He transformed the Comptroller’s Office from a typical, inefficient government bureaucracy into a nation-leading model of results-oriented service. He’s going to do the same thing for the Governor’s Office as our next Governor.
Peter is leading the field in poll after poll, and he’s gained more endorsements than any other candidate. We have the momentum in this race, and with your help, we can widen our lead even further. Click here to help us meet our $13,000 fundraising goal by our June 30 deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/juneeom_0629?amount=20.22]
Thank you,
Tom

Any donation you can afford to give means a lot to Cheri, to me, and to our whole team.
#

Hey there - it’s Travis, Cheri’s campaign manager.
I know we’ve sent y’all a ton of messages this week in the lead up to tomorrow night’s FEC fundraising deadline. So, before I ask for your contribution, I wanted to take a second to explain exactly why these deadlines are so important to the success of our campaign.
After these official deadlines, the Federal Election Commission (FEC for short) requires candidates for federal office to file a report that outlines how much money they’ve raised and from whom.
Every candidate, from the House of Representatives all the way to President, is required to file one of these reports publicly. And once we close the books after midnight tomorrow night, we will do just that.
These reports are a big deal — the media looks at them and writes stories about our campaign, and our opponents will certainly be scouring our reports for any signs of weakness or vulnerability. They’re desperate to find some evidence that Democrats aren’t fired up or don’t believe this team can elect Cheri to be North Carolina’s next senator.
This is our first FEC deadline since Cheri became our nominee and Republican super PACs started attacking her on the air, and that means everyone is going to be looking extra closely at our report. With so many eyes on our campaign, we can’t afford to fall short now.

I want to be clear about something: We’re entering the part of the election cycle where Republicans will launch new unfounded attacks on me every day. I’m ready for it, but I wanted to make sure you never lose sight of why we’re in this campaign – and in this fight for the U.S. Senate.
We all have our own reasons for getting involved in public service (getting involved can mean volunteering, donating, or just voting by the way!), and I wanted to share one of mine:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47160830/353279013/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1232-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDEzZDA1ZS1kZWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntBhPMwO1N9uQBeSjJbrQGJ0qZX4dJWcmd-KdQ0pQYI=)
This is a photo of me and my son Ben. I first got my start in public service as an advocate, helping to ensure that children like Ben, who experiences severe disabilities, would be fully included in their communities and have the same opportunities that all parents want for their children.
Serving the people of New Hampshire as State Senator, Governor, and now U.S. Senator has been the honor of my life. And I'm committed to continue delivering on the issues that matter most to Granite Staters.
I'm writing today because I won my last race by just 1,017 votes in one of the closest Senate races in history, and this year the stakes are even higher.
**When you win by less than half a percentage point, your campaign has to be as strong as possible in every aspect.**
That's where you come in: **[Winning and preserving our Democratic majority in the Senate will take all of us coming together, so I hope I can count on you. If you believe in our grassroots-powered movement, will you please rush $3 or more before our end-of-quarter deadline?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47160831/353279014/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1232-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDEzZDA1ZS1kZWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ntBhPMwO1N9uQBeSjJbrQGJ0qZX4dJWcmd-KdQ0pQYI=)**
Thank you so much.
With every good wish,

clean_body: We all have our own reasons for getting involved in public service and I wanted to share one of mine | | | Hi there, I want to be clear about something: We’re entering the part of the election cycle where Republicans will launch new unfounded attacks on me every day. I’m ready for it, but I wanted to make sure you never lose sight of why we’re in this campaign – and in this fight for the U.S. Senate. We all have our own reasons for getting involved in public service (getting involved can mean volunteering, donating, or just voting by the way!), and I wanted to share one of mine: = This is a photo of me and my son Ben. I first got my start in public service as an advocate, helping to ensure that children like Ben, who experiences severe disabilities, would be fully included in their communities and have the same opportunities that all parents want for their children. Serving the people of New Hampshire as State Senator, Governor, and now U.S. Senator has been the honor of my life. And I'm committed to continue delivering on the issues that matter most to Granite Staters. I'm writing today because I won my last race by just 1,017 votes in one of the closest Senate races in history, and this year the stakes are even higher. subject: BLM vs Blexit
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - Black Lives Matter. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9363%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=irIUD8mnRZV50b6JpWDQLA&sysid=1)
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36036%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xNx3GQ74Tkq9%2bWoyPgVg%2bw&sysid=1)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36037%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nuWbhFip98HgdAzb%2bDxTCg&sysid=1)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36038%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YWobB%2bm9h%2b2pRCW0Ba72rw&sysid=1)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here’s how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c36039%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IWA5SFlMZwZbCWoy8DfTXQ&sysid=1)

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

The Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade has jeopardized lives across America.
Folks, the road ahead is challenging, but we cannot give up.
I believe that just as everyone is entitled to quality health care, so too are people entitled to make the best reproductive health decisions for themselves and their families — including access to safe, legal abortion.
While that right is still protected in Maryland, we must do more. According to the CDC, Black women are over three times more likely than white women to die from a pregnancy-related complication, and in some parts of the country, this disparity is frighteningly worse. In many neighborhoods of color as well as in many low-income communities, including predominately white communities, the quality of available healthcare is worse, making delivery much more deadly, and in the case of unplanned pregnancies, making economic hardship a virtual certainty in addition to health risks.
That’s why this session, I fought to protect abortion access by passing legislation to train and retain certified medical professionals who are equipped to provide much-needed care to Marylanders.
We must protect access to safe, legal abortions, as well as expand the social safety net so families can afford pregnancies should they decide to carry to term. This includes getting children the quality early interventions that lead them to success and making education available and free for those trying to escape cycles of poverty.
Please, will you chip in whatever you can now to support our Get Out the Vote effort and help meet our June goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2022email?refcode=junemail] We have to report our fundraising numbers on our July 2 filing, and we need strong results to show the depth and breadth of support for our campaign and reproductive rights in Maryland.
I'm ready to keep fighting for our progressive values in the Maryland House of Delegates, and I’m proud to stand with Speaker Adrienne Jones in her commitment to passing a Maryland constitutional amendment that will further protect the hard-won freedoms to grow or start a family.
But with Election Day less than 3 weeks away, I need your help right now to fuel our Get Out The Vote operation.
Yes, I'll give now! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2022email?refcode=junemail]
Together, we can make it through these tough times,
Jazz
As a proven progressive leader and champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son.

That’s why this session, I fought to protect abortion access by passing legislation to train and retain certified medical professionals who are equipped to provide much-needed care to Marylanders. We must protect access to safe, legal abortions, as well as expand the social safety net so families can afford pregnancies should they decide to carry to term. This includes getting children the quality early interventions that lead them to success and making education available and free for those trying to escape cycles of poverty. Please, will you chip in whatever you can now to support our Get Out the Vote effort and help meet our June goal? [] We have to report our fundraising numbers on our July 2 filing, and we need strong results to show the depth and breadth of support for our campaign and reproductive rights in Maryland. I'm ready to keep fighting for our progressive values in the Maryland House of Delegates, and I’m proud to stand with Speaker Adrienne Jones in her commitment to passing a Maryland constitutional amendment that will further protect the hard-won freedoms to grow or start a family. But with Election Day less than 3 weeks away, I need your help right now to fuel our Get Out The Vote operation. Yes, I'll give now! [] Together, we can make it through these tough times, Jazz As a proven progressive leader and champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son. body:

| Hey Derek, we have an update for you. John
Hi Derek! Hope you don’t mind Mom + Dad adding you to the group chat. ❤️ Gisele |
| Here’s the situation: I just got a text from Brendan, my campaign manager. 😍 We’re still about **$62,000** short of our EOQ goal. John
Uh-oh. In case you were wondering, Derek, EOQ means “end-of-quarter”. It’s one of the biggest fundraising deadlines of the entire campaign. Gisele |
| That’s exactly right, G. These deadlines MATTER. John
| **Our end-of-quarter deadline is tomorrow night at 11:59 p.m.** After that point, we’re *legally* required to report how much money our campaign raised to the FEC. John
**[It would mean the world to us if you could help João hit his EOQ goal. I know these are stressful times, but please rush a $5 donation right now if you can. | It goes without saying that the stakes of this election just got way, WAY higher after the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade. Send me to Washington, and I’ll be that 51st vote to abolish the filibuster + codify abortion rights into law. John
| And let’s be real, we *really* can’t have someone like Dr. Oz in the Senate. John
It’ll take a lot of resources to win this race and compete with what we’re up against. We’ll need a rush of donations in these final 36 hours to catch up on our EOQ goal. I’d be more worried, but I just *know* we have the most incredible grassroots team. Gisele |
| We sure do, honey. 🥰 This team *always* steps up 💯 John
| With our deadline coming up quickly, we’re humbly asking for your help today. John
**[We’d be so grateful for any amount you can contribute before tomorrow’s deadline. We’ll keep you updated on our progress towards this important goal. Team — Ashley here, I wanted to check in with you real quick. **As a woman and a veteran, the right to an abortion is not about politics for me, it's not a talking point — it's personal.** In the Army, I was stationed in Alabama, Texas, and Kansas. I didn’t get to choose where I lived. If I had been in uniform when _Roe_ was overturned, like my sisters-in-arms are now, I would have had little or no legal access to abortions. With more and more women in the U.S. military, the _Roe v. Wade_ overturning is a matter of national security. Our service members who fought for our freedoms overseas only to see them stripped away in their own country deserve better. Every politician who enabled the Supreme Court to turn the clock backward is responsible for endangering millions of Americans, and Brian Fitzpatrick is one of them. He failed to codify _Roe v. Wade_ when it mattered most, and Pennsylvanians are paying the price for it. The good news is that voters are paying attention, and a recent poll has our movement winning by _10 percentage points_ when Pennsylvanians learn about my opponent’s anti-choice voting record. That means we have a good shot at flipping PA-01 blue, but it’s going to take significant resources and lots of one-on-one conversations to be successful. **[Tomorrow is the last day before the FEC filing deadline closes, and I need you in this fight to win. Things are overwhelming right now, so I want to be very clear about concrete action we can take to fight for abortion rights — and I want to be precise about how those next steps fit into our larger plan. Pure and simple, we don’t have the votes in the Senate right now to codify Roe v. Wade’s protections into federal law. To be exact, we are two votes short. But we can change that in November. To be clear: Growing our Senate majority is not the only part of my plan to fight back, but it’s a powerfully important step to take, because losing our majority would be disastrous, and we can’t just preserve the current Senate stalemate on Roe’s protections. **In Wisconsin and Pennsylvania — two states that Joe Biden and Kamala Harris won in 2020 — Mandela Barnes and John Fetterman are running to flip Republican-held Senate seats. Mandela and John both support ending the filibuster to pass legislation that would ensure abortion rights nationwide.** **If we expand our Democratic majority by two votes, and if we hold onto the House, we can make Roe the law of the land as soon as January. clean_body: This is not the only part of my plan to fight back, but it’s a powerful step. | | | Things are overwhelming right now, so I want to be very clear about concrete action we can take to fight for abortion rights — and I want to be precise about how those next steps fit into our larger plan. Pure and simple, we don’t have the votes in the Senate right now to codify Roe v. Wade’s protections into federal law. To be exact, we are two votes short. But we can change that in November. To be clear: Growing our Senate majority is not the only part of my plan to fight back, but it’s a powerfully important step to take, because losing our majority would be disastrous, and we can’t just preserve the current Senate stalemate on Roe’s protections. In Wisconsin and Pennsylvania — two states that Joe Biden and Kamala Harris won in 2020 — Mandela Barnes and John Fetterman are running to flip Republican-held Senate seats. Mandela and John both support ending the filibuster to pass legislation that would ensure abortion rights nationwide. If we expand our Democratic majority by two votes, and if we hold onto the House, we can make Roe the law of the land as soon as January. That’s well worth fighting for. = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | | | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Every contribution adds up to build a groundswell of grassroots support — which is exactly what we’ll need to expand our Senate majority and enshrine abortion rights into federal law. The Supreme Court doesn’t get the last word in a democracy. We the people can fight back. And we must. As we build our organizing power ahead of November’s midterms, I’ll also keep working to support statewide ballot measures and downballot Democrats who can fight for abortion access at the state level now that Roe’s federal protections are gone. We need to flip state legislatures blue, whether that means you get involved in a local race or run for office yourself. I won’t sugarcoat it: We have a long fight ahead. Derek,

Back in 2020, Republicans poured millions of dollars into a campaign aimed
at defeating me, and they failed. Their attacks, however, have only grown
in magnitude.

Months before Election Day, Kevin McCarthy is campaigning for the
Speakership and a Republican House Majority by threatening to remove me
from my committee assignments, and retaliate against anyone who tried to
hold Trump accountable.

Alongside that, Trump and the Fox News Misinformation Machine have been
relentless in peddling lies about me and smearing my name — knowing that
I’m running in a new district where tens of thousands of voters have never
seen my name on a ballot before the primary.

First impressions are everything, and I can’t afford to sit by and let
Republicans paint a false picture of me and the work I’ve done to help
working families.

They may have endless Fox News headlines and millions of dark money
dollars on their side, but I have you. We can overcome their efforts – but
only if we band together before this all-important FEC deadline at
midnight tomorrow.

name: Tom Brejcha
subject: 9 felonies for exposing Planned Parenthood
body:
Dear Friend, I'm writing this letter to you today because, quite frankly, David Daleiden cannot. You may remember David as the undercover journalist who spent 30 months investigating and capturing video evidence of Planned Parenthood 's top leadership --- medical directors, national program directors, even its Senior Director of Medical Services -- **callously negotiating the harvesting and sale of aborted baby body parts.** **And now, he’s been charged with nine bogus felonies.** **[Which is why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation to the DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63198%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zfHF560ApzabKYCHquZK8Q&sysid=1)** You see, after David released the shocking videos of the illegal and disgusting actions of abortion executives, Kamala Harris, then California's Attorney General, colluded with Planned Parenthood to file felony charges against David... _**... Kamala Harris even ordered the California Department of Justice to raid David's home and confiscate his unpublished videos.**_ I won't sugarcoat it. If not cleared of these charges, David faces steep fines and years in state penitentiary and the consequences of being a convicted felon. While Kamala Harris --- a bought-and-paid-for ally of the abortion industry --- is sitting one heartbeat away from the presidency. That's the bad news. But here's the good news... David is fighting back. In fact, he's taking another opportunity to drag more of Planned Parenthood's dark criminality into the spotlight with two new federal lawsuits. That's right. The Thomas More Society has filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in California on behalf of David against former California Attorney General and now VicePresident Kamala Harris for prosecuting David in bad faith, twisting and perverting California's anti-eavesdropping law to persecute a citizen journalist because of his political views. Then the Thomas More Society filed a defamation (libel) lawsuit in federal court in New York against Planned Parenthood, which said David created a "fake" and "false" "smear campaign" against Planned Parenthood. In other words, the best defense is a good offense. The truth is we could no longer let David suffer such a trampling of his free speech and due process rights without a counterattack. The timing couldn't be more important. This is a critical opportunity to put Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the rest of the abortion industry on trial for conspiring to silence David in order to cover-up their illegal activities. **[That's where your emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND comes in --- by giving today you can stand with David in his hour of need.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63199%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7pb7KawdnQ51xg0DHq0%2fqQ&sysid=1)** The reality is. . . You couldn't be there when David entered the dark underbelly of the abortion industry --- sitting across the table from abortionists haggling over the price of baby body parts with cold-blooded clarity... "I want a Lamborghini." You couldn't be there as David saw with his own eyes the preborn children who had been killed with great precision and delicacy to preserve their organs for maximum profit. You couldn't be there when the videos were released and Kamala Harris and Planned Parenthood conspired to crush David with trumped up legal charges and an armed raid on his home in which they seized laptops, hard-drives, and recording equipment. And you couldn't be there with David (our criminal defense team was there) when he voluntarily appeared in both Texas and California for booking and processing --- fingerprinted and photographed for a mugshot like a common criminal. But, now, this is the reality... there is something you can do. **[You can make an emergency donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND to help vindicate this pro-life hero.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63190%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xHa5ZhycllFGlIcf28zMJA&sysid=1)** My name is Tom Brejcha. I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society --- a not-for-profit law firm underwriting and helping to spearhead David's criminal defense. The Thomas More Society is proud to have defended many renowned pro-life and religious leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe, Ann, and Eric Scheidler, the Pro-Life Action League, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, David Bereit, Lila Rose and Live Action, Students for Life, Sidewalk Advocates for Life, Created Equal, former Kansas Attorney General Phill Kline, the March for Life, and many more. Because when dark forces like Planned Parenthood unleash their full might to legally, financially, and personally destroy our clients --- **we fight back.** I have to tell you, despite all that David is facing, his spirits remain high. Of course, I've never known anyone in this kind of position who didn't feel an empty pit in his stomach. But David's not giving up. His willingness to fight back is a true profile in Pro-Life courage. Now I'll get right down to it... **We anticipate David's legal defense will cost us more than $6 million. That's right, SIX MILLION DOLLARS.** In addition to the criminal case and the new federal civil rights and defamation lawsuits, we're currently representing David in THREE other cases.
* The civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood where we are appealing the jury's verdict, along with the judge's order permanently banning David from doing any more undercover journalism against Planned Parenthood. Recently, we posted a $700,000 appeal bond to keep Planned Parenthood’s nasty collection agents from harassing him with collection agents and even seizing his belongings. We’re fighting back, but we’ll need your help.

* The civil lawsuit brought by the National Abortion Federation and the "gag order" injunction that still prohibits David from releasing any more of his video evidence exposing Planned Parenthood's illegal fetal tissue business. And now, in light of the Planned Parenthood civil lawsuit, NAF has moved for summary judgment - they want a ruling against David without a trial at all!

* And finally, the civil lawsuit filed by Planned Parenthood personnel in federal court in Seattle, where we just achieved a victory for a second time on appeal, but it appears we may need at least a third victory on appeal before this case ends.

That's why David needs your financial support today. **[And that's why I'm praying you will donate $35 or more to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND right away.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63191%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=i%2buBRa2Y0MNSyvWLTf8geg&sysid=1)** I won't guess how much you're able to send today. Whether it's $35, $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, $1,000 or more... ... I will only say that time is of the essence. So I do ask that you make your donation as soon as you can. **This truly is a "David versus Goliath" type of battle --- with Kamala Harris, Planned Parenthood, and the radical left arrayed against our "David."** It's a grave injustice that David is the one being hit with felony charges and massive civil penalties while Planned Parenthood (so far, at least) has gone unpunished. By clearing David of these charges... you and I can allow him to continue with his incredibly important lifesaving work. Remember, over 12 million people on YouTube alone watched the shocking footage he captured. Since that time, 26 states --- over half the country -- have moved to strip Planned Parenthood of taxpayer funding. It's no wonder Planned Parenthood and their allies want to destroy David. They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal and inhumane activities. You and I cannot let that happen. **[So please don't delay. Donate $35, $50, $100, or more to stand with David Daleiden today.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63192%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=03EjXdAH2KbeUqXB4xW7vw&sysid=1)** I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get it so I can let David know that you're standing with him. I know he'll be deeply touched by your generous support. May God Bless You, Tom Brejcha

They'd love to see him rotting away in penitentiary rather than exposing their criminal, ghoulish activities. You and I cannot let that happen. Can I count on you to support the official criminal defense of David Daleiden? **[David is a pro-life hero. Will you make a generous donation to the DAVID DALEIDEN DEFENSE FUND of $35, $50, $100 or more to stop this attempt to crush him?](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63193%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QsArOSfzqtieqft%2b%2bzo2og&sysid=1)** [**DONATE**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63194%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FIxGbM75hpipPtqvz1VqKQ&sysid=1) [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63105%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2ftFy7HyGXfTTnN9Ipr7tbQ&sysid=1) The Thomas More Society is a not-for-profit, national public interest law firm dedicated to restoring respect in law for life, family, and religious liberty. Elections matter. I know you know this.
When I put my name on the ballot in 2018, I thought it was the most important election in my lifetime. In 2020, I felt that way again. We all knew how high the stakes were then. And now, as we have seen over the last few weeks through the work of the House January 6 Committee how perilously close we came to having our voices and votes nullified by a President who refused to accept the results, I feel that way again.
I hope you agree this year’s midterms are just as important as any election we have had. It’s not a Presidential election year. But the stakes are as high as ever. Our democracy is on the line. As are our fundamental freedoms.
And with no Presidential race and no U.S. Senate race in Texas, my name will be the first one on the ballot in November. As the person at the top of the ballot, I am taking seriously my responsibility to get people to the polls and to help elect Democrats up and down the ballot. We’ve shown we can do it in 2018 and 2020, and we are going to do it again in 2022.
But that takes work. Whether it’s a strong field program to connect with voters in person or persuasive and motivating messages in the mail or online or on TV — as you’ve heard me say before — it all takes money.
That’s why I am so grateful to you for your continued and generous support. And if you could help us with a contribution before tomorrow’s deadline, it would be so helpful. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220629?refcode=lpfe220629_m]

name: Aadland for Colorado
subject: A word from Erik about the win
body:
| | | |
---
---
|
---
---
|
# Thank You
---
|
---
| "Today, I am overwhelmed with gratitude for the phenomenal support on so many levels that secured last night's victory. Our success was truly due to the efforts of my incredible staff, loyal supporters, generous donors and extraordinary family.
Across Colorado and District 7, I was constantly encouraged by the constituents I met on the road, at the many meetings, events, forums and debates. CD7 is filled with hard-working Americans who truly want the best for our precious country. I know we have hard work ahead, but I am confident that joined together, Coloradans who desire a brighter future will see us to victory in November.
Truth is, Coloradans in CD7 are done being told what to do, what to believe, and how to think. I will go to Washington as a servant-leader to the voters of CD7- I will fight for you and your families, protecting your constitutional rights like a Lion.
Thank you to all who have supported, encouraged, contributed, endorsed and voted for me--I will not let you down!"
---
|
---
| |
---
---
|
## A brief bio of Erik Aadland
---
| |
---
| Erik Aadland was born into a patriotic Army family as the son of Major General (Ret) Anders and Sandra Aadland. Moving over 21 times, Aadland graduated from High School in Heidelberg, Germany, then went on to attend the United States Military Academy at West Point, NY. Graduating in 2002 not long after 9/11, Aadland was commissioned an Army officer and served with combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, during which he received two Bronze Stars (one for valor).
Aadland left the Army as a Captain in 2011 to pursue a career in the Oil and Natural Gas industry, which culminated in a position as a Project Manager managing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. After leaving his company in 2020, Aadland finished his master's degree in Depth Psychology from Pacifica Graduate Institute. While working to become a counselor to help veterans and trauma victims, Aadland recognized that radical Progressive policies were harming everyday Coloradans, endangering their freedoms and imperiling his children's future, which eventually resulted in him entering the political arena. With the country's future imperiled by a corrupt establishment, Aadland once again feels called to honor his oath to defend the US Constitution by running for Congress, committed to putting Colorado and her people first. Aadland's proudest accomplishment is his marriage of 15 years, out of which he has three children. He currently resides in the front range of the Colorado Rocky Mountains.

Friend -- Congratulations to Senator Darren Bailey on his well-earned victory in the Illinois Republican Primary last night. I urge you and all Republicans to vote for Senator Bailey in the general election this November against JB Pritzker. Thank you to everyone that supported us during this campaign. Words cannot convey our gratitude for the trust that you placed in us. We would particularly like to thank our spouses and families who endured the crucible of a campaign and kept us grounded during the highs and motivated during the lows. We also need to acknowledge our county and township directors who donated tremendous amounts of time and treasure without receiving any monetary compensation whatsoever. We are proud to call you our friends. I also need to thank Carolyn Schofield for agreeing to go on this journey with me. Partnering with Carolyn was the best decision I made during this campaign. She is a tremendous leader and I look forward to helping with whatever future endeavors she pursues. In closing, we can only control our actions--we can't control outcomes. We ran the best campaign possible with the resources we had, facing some challenging circumstances. It was our honor and privilege to work hard for you and spread our message of "commonsense conservative leadership we can trust." Please continue to fight hard and smart for the future of our state and country. God bless and Semper Fidelis, Paul Paul Schimpf

Peter, it's Trudy. I just left a meeting with my team, and I've got good news and bad news.
**The good news is that our grassroots fundraising in the last few days has been _record breaking_.** I am so humbled and honored by this incredible outpouring of support for our campaign.
I know that politics and advocacy can feel pretty hopeless these days; that feeling is, in part, why I am running for Senate in the first place. It's too tempting to just give up and tune out when you're faced with so much hatred, extremism, and cynicism. That's why watching so many of you join my campaign, stand with me against these forces, and believe in a better future truly inspires me.
But like I said, I've got bad news too. **Despite all of the generous support we've been getting, we're still only 64% of the way to our grassroots goal for our FEC end-of-quarter deadline which is tomorrow at midnight.**

This is the biggest fundraising deadline of our campaign so far, so we really can't fall short.

Friend – since my daughter, Jaime, was murdered in the Parkland school shooting, I've dedicated my life to gun safety reform. And this news made me sick to my stomach:

**Marco Rubio voted AGAINST a bipartisan gun safety bill. And just two days later, Trump-appointed Supreme Court justices ruled AGAINST a gun safety law.**
**I'm OUTRAGED that our country's leaders flat-out REFUSE to protect our communities from gun violence. There have been 269 mass shootings so far this year – and as long as far-right leaders remain in power, there will be more. [That's why I'm working with Val Demings to help her defeat Rubio, protect our Democratic majority and confirm Supreme Court justices who believe in gun safety reform. If you're with me, will you donate $5 right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47166425/353303120/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3625-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmN2FlYjU3NS1lZWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vnwPiHZokl6LN6YTajoAc62TZh7i6VwftYBCwxVQoC4=)**
Marco Rubio is a coward. Just a week after my daughter was murdered, I demanded that he protect children from gun violence – and he couldn't even look me in the eye. Since then, he's refused to work with Parkland survivors, he's voted to confirm Supreme Court justices who don't believe in gun safety – and he still refuses to take the bare minimum action to curb gun violence after an assault weapon killed _19_ _ELEMENTARY SCHOOL CHILDREN_ and two adults _ _ in Texas._ _

Tonio Burgos has earned millions lobbying for oil producer Williams Companies, and is currently lobbying for Valero, the world’s largest petroleum refiner. He has also lobbied for National Grid. After facing public backlash, former U.S. Rep. Joe Kennedy returned money from Burgos in his 2020 campaign against U.S. Sen. Ed Markey. No politician should accept campaign donations from the fossil fuel industry, let alone have one of their top lobbyists hold a fundraiser at his lobbying firm. We could be up against some big fossil fuel money in this race, Friend. Since Cynthia and I won’t accept any money from corporate lobbyists, corporate PACs, or fossil fuel executives, it’ll be up to grassroots supporters (like everyone reading this email) to help us beat this fossil fuel influence. **** The fossil fuel industry is threatening our planet – we already see the forest fires, floods, and extreme heat they’ve caused. We need leaders who will fight to shut them down, not who will cozy up to their lobbyists in exchange for campaign funds. The stakes of this election could not be higher for our futures. I’d really appreciate whatever you can do to help us win a government that will fight with everything we have to stop the climate crisis. ## A win for the hard-working people of Illinois' 14th Congressional District

| OSWEGO, Ill. (June 29, 2022) - After securing the Republican Party nomination to challenge Lauren Underwood for the right to represent Illinois' 14th Congressional District, Kendall County Board Chairman, Scott Gryder released the following statement:
> "To all who gave their precious time, resources, and votes, thank you!
> Because of your support, our campaign for the future of Illinois' 14th Congressional District continues.
> Lauren Underwood is in trouble because we are in the grips of the worst economy in over 40 years. With gas, groceries, medicine, rent, and everything else skyrocketing in price, the results of this primary show people are concerned and focused on the rising cost of everyday necessities.
> We need to change course, away from the failing policies and leadership Joe Biden and his allies in Congress like Lauren Underwood are offering, toward pro-growth, pro-family, pro-freedom policies backed by leaders who know how to get the job done.
> While honored to be nominated as your messenger of change as we carry on toward November 8, this election was a win for the hard-working people of the 14th District who need real relief, not more of the same."
Illinois' 14th Congressional District encompasses all or part of seven counties, including Bureau, DeKalb, Kane, Kendall, LaSalle, Will, and Putnam. clean_body: We need to elect more working people like Mandela to office. | | | Big news out of Wisconsin, Peter: Mandela Barnes is not only leading his Democratic primary, but he’s also now beating Republican Senator Ron Johnson by a larger margin than any of his primary opponents too: Marquette University Law Poll (June 22, 2022) Mandela Barnes (D) 46% Ron Johnson (R) 44% If we’re going to gain the Senate seats we need to end the filibuster, codify abortion rights into law, and move a people’s agenda through Congress, we need to elect more working people like Mandela to office — not another billionaire corporate Democrat. And with just 41 days to go until the Wisconsin primary, this is one of our biggest opportunities on the entire map this year to flip a seat from red to blue and replace a Republican with a real working families champion. At every step of the way, Senator Ron Johnson has failed Wisconsin working families. He was deeply involved in Donald Trump’s effort to overturn the 2020 election, he has dismissed the horrific effects repealing Roe will have on people in Wisconsin and across the country, he voted against the bipartisan gun violence bill this month, and he’s abandoned his constituents on issue after issue. Working Families Party organizers are already on the ground in Wisconsin to support Mandela Barnes, and we have big plans to reach and mobilize voters over the next 41 days. body:
The fight for District 30 is here, let's accomplish this together. | | | [](https://jamesrodgersforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=832d15fe4bac469b8dcf34ddf&id=a3590b1e15&e=0130f1c7b7)

Friends,James Rodgers here, your Republican nominee for TX-30! I wanted to graciously thank every one of you for supporting my campaign and helping us achieve a major victory earlier this month during the primary! I could not have accomplished this without the overwhelming support from the Dallas community.After spending some much-needed time with my family and deep prayer, I am ready to take on this fight for November! I’ve had people tell me that this fight is a lost cause, that I will be going up against the Goliath that is the Democratic political machine of Dallas. Well, if my opponent is Goliath, I’d like to consider myself the David of this story.

We **CAN **flip this seat with the right resources and strategy.
Crippling inflation, record-high gas prices, disastrous foreign policy... The list can go on, but one thing is clear: American families are under attack because of dangerous Leftist policies.But where there is darkness, there is light. The average American is waking up to the destructive policies of the Democratic Party. The fear for our children’s future is transcending any divisive rhetoric that the Left is pushing. We saw that with the tremendous win by Mayra Flores in South Texas as she flipped a seat that had never been held by a Republican before.That is why **NOW **is the perfect time to flip this seat. Voters want to see a solution-based candidate who will fight to improve their lives, not another AOC-wannabe who will do nothing but add to partisan gridlock.Join me in my fight to restore integrity to this seat. It will take every ounce of grit and determination to win this battle, but it must be done to protect the future of our country. | | | Hey Peter, I know you’re busy but I wanted to make sure you caught Kevin’s message the other day.

Our primary win was the first giant step in getting Kevin to Congress, but we have a long way to go until November and only four short days until our FIRST major general election quarterly fundraising deadline, **[so like Kevin said, we need your help now more than ever to march toward victory in November. Can you chip in today?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=fa857ba52e&e=292fde286a)**

We’ve earned the sole backing of respected and accomplished leaders including Congresswoman Jackie Speier, the California Democratic Party, civil rights icon Dolores Huerta, a dozen labor unions, over a hundred federal, state, local leaders, and grassroots supporters like you. And just the other day we won the highly sought after backing of my former competitor and Burlingame Councilmember Emily Beach who racked up 20,760 votes of her own in the primary. **This grassroots momentum wouldn’t be possible without you, Peter, and that’s why I’m calling on all of our core supporters to chip in before our June 30th deadline.** [Can I count on you to give $25, $50, or $100 before our Thursday night deadline?](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=b39b6dac53&e=292fde286a)

It’s the perfect way to build on our resounding first-place primary finish earlier this month, in which we bested our closest competitor by nearly 2-to-1.

It is both exciting and deeply encouraging to see the volunteer ranks of Team Mullin continue to grow. As our momentum builds and we continue to consolidate the Democratic field around our proven progressive platform, I will need your help more than ever before to keep our campaign gaining speed and moving forward towards an overwhelming victory in November.

**Peter, in just a matter of days, our campaign is up against our first critical general election test of our strength, the all-important June quarterly deadline.**[Can you chip in $25, $50, or $100 right now to help us meet our quarterly deadline goal? Every dollar helps get us closer.](https://kevinmullinforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31b479dbea5973b27a9d19670&id=ee0efe81a9&e=292fde286a)

Kevin Mullin

Friend,

We’re in the midst of a precarious moment in American politics. And it’s clear that if we don’t chart the right course from here, our very democracy could suffer irreparable harm.

What really stood out to me as I watched the January 6th Committee hearings is that we have a large and vocal cohort of American leaders that do want to chart the right course. People that are willing to speak truth to power, put country over partisanship, and protect our sacred democratic principles.

Of course, that work isn’t just confined to congressional hearing rooms. That’s the very work Jocelyn is doing every day as Secretary of State. And that’s the work that you’re supporting as a member of our Team Benson community.

Friend, Michigan is at the very heart of this historic nationwide fight for democracy. And Jocelyn’s leadership is critical to winning it. body:
We are 20 days away from the July 19th primary! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/aef2f3e2e4b8/weekly-round-up-11817703?e=64ac72257a)
---
| |
---
| | Twenty days to go!

The July 19th primary election is right around the corner - we are only three weeks away!

Every single day, Jeff and I are out and about meeting with Marylanders, sharing our vision for the future or the state, and our commitment to make Maryland more affordable and the best place to live, work, raise a family and retire.

We are so thankful for the support we are receiving out on the trail, but we need to make sure that everybody goes out and votes for us, tell your family, tell your friends, and tell your neighbors.
Make sure that you have a plan to vote. Here’s some important information for you to remember:

**Mail-In Ballots:**
* Mail-in ballots have been sent out. For those who have received a mail-in ballot postmark it by July 19th
* If you would like to request a mail-in ballot, you can do so until July 12th
* Request your mail-in ballot here: [https://voterservices.elections.maryland.gov/onlinemailinrequest/InstructionsStep1](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=a56c68abc6&e=64ac72257a)

**Early Voting:**
* Early voting begins on July 7th and concludes on July 14th
* Find your early voting center here: [https://elections.maryland.gov/elections/2022/2022_Early%20Voting_Centers.pdf](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=bdb77698de&e=64ac72257a)

**Election Day:**
* July 19th is Election Day, polls will be open from 7 AM – 8 PM

Ever since we entered this race we have made issues of affordability a centerpiece of our campaign. For months we have been sounding the alarm on the Inflation Tax and the out-of-control cost of gas.

On July 1st, the gas tax will increase by a staggering 18% due to the Inflation Tax. Maryland is one of a handful of states to index the gas tax to inflation - so when inflation goes up, so does the gas tax. In 2013, legislators passed the Inflation Tax so that they could avoid having to vote on the record for tax increases.
I was proud to have voted against this legislation, it was wrong then, and it is wrong now.

Marylanders need relief, not more burdensome tax increases.

I am the only candidate in this race who will fight to repeal the Inflation Tax during my first year in office.

Last week we called on Comptroller Peter Franchot to halt the Inflation Tax and for there to be a special session to suspend our state’s gas tax. Marylanders need relief, and I won’t stop fighting until we make our state more affordable. That is my commitment to you when I am your next governor.

We had some great events and campaign stops last week where we met lots of enthusiastic voters who want to continue to move our state in the right direction.

We had a great meet and greet with women-owned business owners in Frederick County. Small businesses are the backbone of our economy, and I’m proud that while I was at the Secretary of Commerce, Maryland led the way for women and minority-owned businesses. We’ll continue to uplift small businesses.

On Wednesday, Jeff and I made a number of stops in Carroll County as part of a tour to connect with community organizations that are truly making a positive difference. We stopped at the Carroll County Arts Center, the Boys and Girls Club, and Exploration Center.

Later that evening Jeff spoke with Montgomery County Republicans.

I followed up our day in Carroll County with some really great events in Timonium, Stevensville, and Montgomery County.

Jeff went on a campaign swing through Western Maryland where he completed some retail political stops at businesses, attended a GOP Lincoln Day Dinner, and spent time with Delegate Wendell Beitzel and Senator George Edwards, who have previously endorsed our campaign and have served our state and their communities well in the General Assembly.

Other highlights for Jeff and me on the campaign trail this week included stops with the Lisbon Fire Company, a GOP cookout in Harford, stops at the Frederick Farmers Market, and the carnival in Thurmont!

Jeff also got to see a parrot at the Talbot County GOP candidate palooza and he even got to meet some folks in a town called “Woolford”...

We ended the week at the Hereford Independence Day Parade. I was glad to be a part of this great community tradition and enjoyed meeting so many Marylanders up and down the parade route. Thank you everybody for coming out!

I loved meeting these young ladies along the parade route!

Thank you for your support,

Peter,
Throughout my career, I have always felt that standing up for what is right is just as important as following the laws that guide my work.
But when the law is unjust, we cannot wait to take action.
Today I had the opportunity to speak about the decision to overturn Roe v. Wade – while surrounded by young folks who are frustrated & concerned about the direction that our country is headed.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wade2022?refcode=whem0629 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wade2022?refcode=whem0629]
Speaking at Johnson Square in Savannah alongside State Rep. Edna Jackson, State Rep. Derek Mallow, & Anne Allen Westbrook, candidate for Georgia State House District 163.
Gov. Kemp is already moving to enact one of the most restrictive abortion bans in the country, and Republicans in Washington are already discussing what a national abortion ban would look like.
Buddy Carter and the Republicans are moving full speed ahead to restrict freedoms, place themselves between women and their doctors, and take Georgia & America down a very dangerous path.
Peter, this is unacceptable. I will fight tirelessly to ensure that women will have the freedom and privacy needed to make their own decisions without interference from politicians.
Congress needs to take action and pass legislation that protects a woman’s right to reproductive freedom and privacy.
I pledge to continue standing up for what is right and fighting for the people of Georgia’s 1st District.
Onwards,
Wade Herring

subject: Elissa’s breakdown of the numbers
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220629_2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220629_2&amount=28]
Team,
Tomorrow (!!) is our end-of-quarter deadline – and with the stakes made even higher by the recent SCOTUS decision – it’s an important one. That’s why we wanted to make sure you saw Elissa’s email earlier with a full breakdown of the road ahead and what we’re up against.
We’ll let her explain, but long story short, this is one the most competitive House races in the entire country. That means we’re in for a tough fight, but we’ve handled tough fights before with the help of our grassroots supporters.
You can read more below, and if you’d chip in $5, $10, or $15 before tomorrow’s deadline, we’d be grateful! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220629_2&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220629_2&amount=28]
Team Slotkin
Team,
As we close out the end of June and continue to process the Supreme Court’s reversal of Roe V. Wade, I wanted to take a moment to take stock of where things stand in Michigan’s new 7th district.
I’ve always been a numbers person. I run my campaign with the knowledge of where we’ve been, how we got there, and what we need to do to achieve our goals. So with our end-of-quarter deadline approaching on June 30th, I thought it was a perfect time to take a look at some numbers from my last two races, and how they can inform the fight ahead.
We’ll start at the beginning – when I first ran for office back in 2018:
*

volunteers,

up
the

Then it was on to 2020, where COVID completely upended campaigning as we know it. There’s no playbook to running a campaign during a global pandemic, which just goes to show what a feat we pulled off:
*
Nearly
2,000
volunteers,
many
virtual

*

left
at
doors
(the

of

that
we
nicknamed
“contactless
canvasing”),
half
a

sent,
and
nearly
1

calls
to

vote

*
19
outdoor
community
events

*
15,412
vote
victory
(while
Trump
won
this
district
by
0.8%)

So, with that in mind, let’s take a look at where we are today.
We have a brand-new district to compete in, meaning I’ve gone from running in 2.5 counties to running in 7 counties. That means I’m no longer running to represent some of the incredible Team Slotkin volunteers that have helped us pull off two victories in North Oakland county. It’s a huge loss, but we’re building our network in the new areas of the district. Recently, over 300 volunteers helped us collect 5,000 nominating petition signatures from all 7 counties to get my name on the ballot. And we’ve already had volunteers knock on over 4,000 doors and make over 3,000 phone calls – and it’s only June.
But those aren’t the only numbers we watch. Over $2 million has already been spent in negative digital and television ads against me this year, and a whopping $6.5 million (!) in negative television ads have been reserved for the fall. One outside group in particular, the Congressional Leadership Fund, has spent 3 times more against me already than that had at this point in 2020.
I’ve told you before that my race is the most competitive in Michigan, and one of the most competitive in the entire country – and the proof is in the numbers.
How did we succeed in the past? By securing the resources we needed to succeed well in advance. Deploying yard signs, contacting voters, combating negative ads, and assembling the largest Democratic field campaign in the Midwest takes a lot of time, and a lot of resources. That’s why we wanted to make sure you saw Elissa’s email earlier with a full breakdown of the road ahead and what we’re up against. We’ll let her explain, but long story short, this is one the most competitive House races in the entire country. That means we’re in for a tough fight, but we’ve handled tough fights before with the help of our grassroots supporters. You can read more below, and if you’d chip in $5, $10, or $15 before tomorrow’s deadline, we’d be grateful! [] CONTRIBUTE [] Team Slotkin Team, As we close out the end of June and continue to process the Supreme Court’s reversal of Roe V. Wade, I wanted to take a moment to take stock of where things stand in Michigan’s new 7th district. I’ve always been a numbers person. I run my campaign with the knowledge of where we’ve been, how we got there, and what we need to do to achieve our goals. So with our end-of-quarter deadline approaching on June 30th, I thought it was a perfect time to take a look at some numbers from my last two races, and how they can inform the fight ahead. We’ll start at the beginning – when I first ran for office back in 2018: 1,500 volunteers, making up the largest Democratic field campaign in the Midwest 200,000 doors knocked, 307,130 texts sent, 1 million phone calls to get out the vote 13,098 vote victory Then it was on to 2020, where COVID completely upended campaigning as we know it. There’s no playbook to running a campaign during a global pandemic, which just goes to show what a feat we pulled off: Nearly 2,000 volunteers, many virtual Over 50,000 informational flyers left at doors (the 2020 version of door-knocking that we nicknamed “contactless canvasing”), half a million texts sent, and nearly 1 million phone calls to get out the vote 19 outdoor community events * 15,412 vote victory (while Trump won this district by 0.8%) So, with that in mind, let’s take a look at where we are today. We have a brand-new district to compete in, meaning I’ve gone from running in 2.5 counties to running in 7 counties. That means I’m no longer running to represent some of the incredible Team Slotkin volunteers that have helped us pull off two victories in North Oakland county. It’s a huge loss, but we’re building our network in the new areas of the district. Recently, over 300 volunteers helped us collect 5,000 nominating petition signatures from all 7 counties to get my name on the ballot. And we’ve already had volunteers knock on over 4,000 doors and make over 3,000 phone calls – and it’s only June. But those aren’t the only numbers we watch. Over $2 million has already been spent in negative digital and television ads against me this year, and a whopping $6.5 million (!) in negative television ads have been reserved for the fall. One outside group in particular, the Congressional Leadership Fund, has spent 3 times more against me already than that had at this point in 2020. I’ve told you before that my race is the most competitive in Michigan, and one of the most competitive in the entire country – and the proof is in the numbers. How did we succeed in the past? By securing the resources we needed to succeed well in advance. Deploying yard signs, contacting voters, combating negative ads, and assembling the largest Democratic field campaign in the Midwest takes a lot of time, and a lot of resources. Replicating our success in a brand new district that’s 1,310 square miles larger than the area I currently represent is going to require even more. That’s why I’m asking if you will chip in before our end-of-quarter deadline on June 30th to help me compete in one of the most competitive House races in the country. body:
We need an amendment to the Ohio constitution guaranteeing the fundamental right to reproductive freedom.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47169801/353316433/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTk4YzEzNi1mOGY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RHKlqhPjhlvJMDn1_AACcEpTSHghJwpiQMOVzL_mlYI=)

Team,
Immediately after the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_ , Mike DeWine and the Republicans went into action to restrict abortion rights by implementing their 6-week ban. Other bills are already moving to ban all abortions with no exceptions.
I refuse to accept this, and I know I’m not alone.
Today, I announced that as governor I will support and pass a ballot initiative to put the protections of _Roe v. Wade_ into the Ohio Constitution.
**[Will you join me in the fight to ensure that Ohioans have the right to a safe and legal abortion? If you agree that we must protect abortion rights, chip in to my campaign right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47169802/353316434/-198499754?refcode=nw_em_220629_1_t2_a&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTk4YzEzNi1mOGY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RHKlqhPjhlvJMDn1_AACcEpTSHghJwpiQMOVzL_mlYI=)**
I know that Ohio is a pro-choice state. If Mike DeWine and his extremist allies are going to strip away the rights of 6 million Ohio women, we will take this issue directly to the voters.
Mike DeWine has said he wants to go “as far as possible” to outlaw abortion. He’s ready to decide what care Ohioans can access and put himself in charge of our medical decisions.
**Enshrining the right to reproductive freedom in our constitution would ensure that Ohioans – not politicians – are in charge of our own health care. As governor, I’ll support a ballot initiative because I believe that we must fight back against their extreme agenda and protect women’s rights.**
**[If you agree that Mike DeWine and his Republican allies should not be deciding our medical care, please, pitch in right now to defeat them and elect a pro-choice governor for Ohio.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47169803/353316435/-198499754?refcode=nw_em_220629_1_t2_a&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwMTk4YzEzNi1mOGY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RHKlqhPjhlvJMDn1_AACcEpTSHghJwpiQMOVzL_mlYI=)**
Onward,
Nan Whaley

Dear Peter,

I released the following statement this morning in response to [Denise Merrill's recent resignation from her role as Connecticut Secretary of the State](https://terriewood.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=31c0ff16f808b2d717581f4dc&id=acbd1b658b&e=cd99aa018d):

_(Darien, CT) - Republican Candidate for Secretary of the State Terrie Wood (Republican State Representative - 141) issued the following statement urging Governor Ned Lamont fill the vacancy at the Secretary of the State's Office with a qualified and well-respected individual in light of current Secretary of the State Denise Merrill‘s resignation.

"It is deeply important that Governor Lamont fill the vacancy in Secretary of the State with a well-respected and trusted public servant. I recommend he look to fill the position with someone of the caliber of former Chief Justice Chase Rogers, former State Senator John McKinney, or former Senator Paul Doyle. These public officials are all tremendously qualified and have deep respect throughout our state. They are not marred by scandal from the Port Authority and have the skill set to be successful in this interim time.”

This interim leader has a lot of work to do to prepare for the August 9th primary and the November 8th general election, as the current administration has dropped the ball on providing the public information, preparing for turnout, or helping the Registrars and Town Clerks. Governor Lamont must appoint someone who works well under pressure and has the respect of both sides of the aisle.

I hope the Governor will do the right thing to restore public faith in this role and not appoint a non-elected political operative."_

---
| Warmest regards,
Terrie

With Senate control split 50-50, losing just one seat in the Senate could halt all of the progress we’ve made so far.
| | | _One seat._ That’s all that stands between us and a Republican-controlled Senate.

You better believe that the GOP is willing to do anything to take back power in this year’s midterms and try to halt all of our progress.

**The hard work we put in now will determine just how aggressively Senate Democrats can campaign to keep control of the majority.** There couldn’t be a more important time to redouble our efforts to organize and protect the right to vote. I need you to dig deep, stand with me, and act.
