body:
To protect our Washington state values, we can't afford to cede an inch.

| [](https://links.e.jayinslee.com/els/v2/8EW3hwAWpgHR/SjljdnRuOVQvVnpDWHNiZXEwZ25QVjlMeERpRC9oTDB1ZHNwRTMvYlhWWSszQmY2NEI2TW9SeGkvRlhEMmdiR2NsTUtZYjBuWkR1VExuUFArbjZmN0IrQmE4dWE4TzdjSkNJODJnUjZsVkE9S0/dDBJYjZaOHMvYXlJaytRUFF4M0lRYm1IdFVDMXJabmFKWnhkUElqVUhjST0S1) Friend, Like you, I am horrified by the Supreme Court's recent radical and regressive attacks on our civil liberties -- a right to a safe, accessible abortion chief among them. Let me be clear: These decisions stem from a national, decades-long Republican effort to take over our courts to force their extremist beliefs on a public that simply does not agree with them. And these radical court decisions are far from over. **Clarence Thomas has already made clear that he wants to come after marriage equality and contraceptives next.** [](https://links.e.jayinslee.com/els/v2/YGD4cE329NS8/SjljdnRuOVQvVnpDWHNiZXEwZ25QVjlMeERpRC9oTDB1ZHNwRTMvYlhWWSszQmY2NEI2TW9SeGkvRlhEMmdiR2NsTUtZYjBuWkR1VExuUFArbjZmN0IrQmE4dWE4TzdjSkNJODJnUjZsVkE9S0/dDBJYjZaOHMvYXlJaytRUFF4M0lRYm1IdFVDMXJabmFKWnhkUElqVUhjST0S1) Frankly, Washington state's Republican Party has the same pro-guns, anti-abortion, homophobic, climate-change-denying agenda. name: Charles Booker
subject: The challenges ahead
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi Peter,

As we wrap up this quarter, I’m thinking about everything we’ve
accomplished in the past three months.

I’m so proud of our team, and how fearless you all have been in fighting
for our values and for the future we want for this country. It’s because
of y’all I was chosen as the first Black Democratic nominee to run for
U.S. Senate in Kentucky. Your support is the reason why we’re able to
build the biggest grassroots movement Kentucky has ever seen. Together,
we’re already making history.

But I know it hasn’t been easy,
Peter. From the Supreme Court
ruling to overturn Roe v. Wade, the violent gun massacres we’ve witnessed
in Uvalde and Buffalo, and the terrifying details we learned of our
leaders' involvement in the January 6 insurrection — it’s clear that there
are many challenges ahead of us to fix our politics.

The stakes of our upcoming election couldn’t be higher. We need to give
everything we’ve got leading up to November to make sure we get the votes
we need in the Senate to abolish the filibuster and finally pass the
solutions our communities need.

That’s why I’m reaching out to ask for a favor before the quarter ends
tomorrow. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220629.-hTD_x&refcode=em20220629-2155&t=1001&akid=2155%2E346206%2EixvKJ8 ]There’s less than 48 hours left until our FEC fundraising
deadline — will you chip in $4.80 or anything you can right now to help us
reach our goal? Every dollar you give directly powers our organizing work
to replace Rand Paul.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220629.-hTD_x&refcode=em20220629-2155&t=1020&akid=2155%2E346206%2EixvKJ8 ]Contribute $4.80

It’s critical we channel our anger into action,
Peter.

We must remember that hopelessness is not the answer. Change is possible
and in our power.

You see, my mom taught me that if you have faith just the size of a
mustard seed, you can move a mountain. And I have faith that we can defeat
Rand Paul and transform our dysfunctional U.S. Senate.

Together, we’re going to fight for a future that lifts up families like
yours and mine. Together, we’ll make sure we have the votes to abolish the
filibuster so we can finally codify Roe v. Wade in law, pass Medicare for
All, and move our fight for racial justice forward. But if we’re going to
do this, I can’t do it alone.

Our grassroots campaign is 100% funded by donations from emails like this.
And we need your help to raise a record number of them today before our
FEC end-of-quarter deadline tomorrow. [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220629.-hTD_x&refcode=em20220629-2155&t=1021&akid=2155%2E346206%2EixvKJ8 ]Will you chip in $4.80 or
anything you can right now to help out?

Let’s do this,

Charles

Former US Congressman, Jim Renacci Named Chairman of “American Greatness”
Today, American Greatness PAC has named Jim Renacci as Chairman of the organization.

AMERICAN GREATNESS exists to further the policies set forth in 2016 of the MAGA Movement. The United States saw unprecedented growth and prosperity under these policies and the only way to restore our American Greatness, is to restore the MAGA policies in our states and across our nation. The movement of good policy supersedes any group or individual, yet will bring prosperity, peace, business growth, and revive the American values that made our country great for 200 years. Now is the time to harness the policy power of the MAGA Movement. With the stakes this high, I have to ask:
| | |
---
Friend —
The Supreme Court has struck down the right to safe and legal abortion, and the protections that generations of Americans were born with are gone. It’s an enormous step back for our country.
In Arizona, Trump just endorsed one of my opponents who wants to go even further and pass a national ban on abortion in all cases — no exceptions. He even opposes the decision that made birth control legal in this country.
The stakes were high before. But after this decision, it’s more critical than ever that we win this race, because the Senate is the final defense against abortion being banned in the United States.
**As long as I’m in the Senate, I’ll work to make sure that never happens.**
**Which is why I have to ask: ****[Will you split a donation between our people-powered campaign and Jacky Rosen today? We can’t let extremists take back this seat and eliminate the right to choose for millions of Americans. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47171729/353323055/-1087597766?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1840-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkY2JkYWQ4Mi1mZWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J5sV8PeYGHGgQRUP3PCBEEeDhMBKGUMtMGJ_DWkBSFQ=)**

Thank you for your support today and always,

Mark Kelly

Fair Fight |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47171745/353323210/1793776944?refcode=em_20220629_f_f_split_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDMzN2JlMC1mZWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JEaFPAUTOGe20ld3WcTSUhS8m3hhVzzHCIDyR64gC2U=&emci=7c337be0-fef7-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=7d337be0-fef7-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=1037277)

| | With the Supreme Court’s ruling last week in _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ ending the constitutional right to abortion, many of us are feeling heartbroken and devastated. The _Dobbs_ decision was regressive in the extreme, and stands in direct opposition to the will of the American people. But, the team here at Fair Fight wants to remind you that there are ways we can fight back — _and we can’t afford to give up_. One way to fight back is to continue the slow and steady work of building power through organizing and voting. **Not all of the answers to the current moment lie in voting. But, the truth is if we don’t vote, this uphill battle will be even steeper. And one of the best things we can do right now is to provide organizing resources and support leaders who are going to use their positions of power to defend our freedoms.** [_**So if you’re able to today, please split a $20 contribution between Fair Fight, Senator Raphael Warnock, and Stacey Abrams to keep a pro-choice vote in the Senate, elect a pro-choice Governor in Georgia, and build critical voter power ahead of the midterms.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47171746/353323211/1977887352?refcode=em_20220629_f_f_split_s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDMzN2JlMC1mZWY3LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JEaFPAUTOGe20ld3WcTSUhS8m3hhVzzHCIDyR64gC2U=) This moment calls us to uplift our communities and to elect leaders who will fight to protect ALL of our freedoms, from the right to an abortion to the right to vote. Stacey Abrams and Raphael Warnock have spoken out time and again to advocate for our reproductive freedom and worked to ensure that all Georgians receive the care and medical services they need and deserve. Meanwhile, their opponents embody the stark opposite of the majority of Americans’ pro-choice and pro-voter values. clean_body: The same legislators pushing to ban abortions also want to restrict our power to vote them out. Fair Fight | | | With the Supreme Court’s ruling last week in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization ending the constitutional right to abortion, many of us are feeling heartbroken and devastated. The Dobbs decision was regressive in the extreme, and stands in direct opposition to the will of the American people. But, the team here at Fair Fight wants to remind you that there are ways we can fight back — and we can’t afford to give up. One way to fight back is to continue the slow and steady work of building power through organizing and voting. Not all of the answers to the current moment lie in voting. But, the truth is if we don’t vote, this uphill battle will be even steeper. And one of the best things we can do right now is to provide organizing resources and support leaders who are going to use their positions of power to defend our freedoms. = This moment calls us to uplift our communities and to elect leaders who will fight to protect ALL of our freedoms, from the right to an abortion to the right to vote. Stacey Abrams and Raphael Warnock have spoken out time and again to advocate for our reproductive freedom and worked to ensure that all Georgians receive the care and medical services they need and deserve. Meanwhile, their opponents embody the stark opposite of the majority of Americans’ pro-choice and pro-voter values. #### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq** Dear Hoosiers, I started my campaign for U.S. Senate early in 2020 because I knew I'd need a head start. Most people start their political journey by starting at the bottom of the ticket and taking the traditional climb to the top. We don't have time for that! I believe in being the change you want to see and starting right now where you know you can make a difference.

Now, look where the country is. It's unbelievable! Gas prices are exploding through the roof! Women's rights have been stripped away. Climate change is on the rise. What's next? I'll tell you what's next. The most disappointing midterms you've ever seen if we don't start strategizing now! Someone once said, "When justice becomes law, resistance becomes duty!"
**Let's get ready to show our resistance and fulfill our duty at the polls! **
**Now, here's what I need you to do right now: **
* Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform them that I meant business when I said I would run for the Senate until _**_we_**_ all win!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=05e5eb595e&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=46124c2265&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=8f8f5ca9e1&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate
2022

body:
Friend -- I'm Retired Navy SEAL Derrick Van Orden and the Trump Conservative Candidate running in Wisconsin’s Third Congressional District. You may not know much about me, but my story isn’t anything like the bigwig Washington politicians. I joined the Navy when I was 18 years old and defended our great nation, serving two combat deployments in Iraq and Afghanistan. I did it for one purpose: to protect our freedoms that we are so privileged to experience. I love my country and I’m not done fighting for it just yet. **So many people today are afraid of being silenced or canceled, but not me. I am proud of who I am and I won’t change for anyone. I am:**
* **TRUMP-ENDORSED******
* **100% MAGA
**
* **PROUD CHRISTIAN GRANDFATHER, FATHER, AND HUSBAND
**
* **PRO-MILITARY, PRO-CAPITALISM, AND PRO-AMERICA FIRST
**
* **AND A PROUD PATRIOT**

name: Michael Bennet
subject: My official GOP opponent
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
Here’s what you need to know about my official GOP opponent...

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=597%2E61531%2E0LJjO4)
Team, it’s official: **Joe O’Dea is my official Republican opponent in the general election.**
Here’s what you need to know about Joe O’Dea:
* He was endorsed by the Colorado NRA and opposes new gun safety legislation that would keep Coloradans safe,
* He came out against Colorado’s law guaranteeing the right to choose,
* And he suggested cutting funding for critical safety nets like Social Security and Medicare.

There’s a saying: _when someone shows you who they are, believe them the first time._
**Team, we know who Joe O’Dea is.** He’s given his own campaign seven-figures so he could buy his way onto the ballot, then he dumped more cash into attack ads to try and win this seat. He’s out of step with Coloradans, and he’ll be a rubber stamp for Rick Scott — who wants to raise taxes for low-income folks and seniors — and Mitch McConnell.
[**Friend, please split a $10 donation between my campaign and Peter Welch to help defend my seat and continue defending our fundamental freedoms.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3050?t=3&akid=597%2E61531%2E0LJjO4)
When it comes to the issues Coloradans care about — like creating jobs, lowering costs, protecting our communities from climate change, and investing in working families — my record stands tall.
But my seat is listed among the 10 most likely Senate seats to flip, and National Republicans have already laid out a roadmap to defeat me. The RNC has already dropped organizers and operatives in Colorado, and Mitch McConnell and the National GOP have already raised over **$200 million** to target races like mine.
Now that O’Dea is the official Republican nominee, their efforts will only ramp up. So I’m asking:
[**Will you split a $10 donation between my campaign and Peter Welch to keep Colorado blue and hold onto our slim Senate majority?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3050?t=4&akid=597%2E61531%2E0LJjO4)
Thank you,
Michael Bennet

Hi there,

I want to be clear: I will always fight to protect a woman’s autonomy and her ability to fully participate in our democracy.

But my opponents won’t.
I can only continue to fight for reproductive freedom if we win reelection here in New Hampshire. Republicans are spending BIG to defeat me – and they think they can do it because I won my last election by only 1,017 votes. **[Please chip in right now, ahead of Thursday’s end-of-quarter deadline, to fight back against anti-choice politicians and keep this seat in Democratic hands. If I lose, we’ll lose the Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47173434/353329750/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1233-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYjc3ZGUxNi0wNGY4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GCWjhvnCtz3dvXvNwb2LmYCZtnSBoTBg4_KQtsY_5Mc=)**
One of my opponents was the architect of New Hampshire’s abortion ban. Another has promised to “end abortion once and for all.” One thing is clear: they would be a rubber stamp for Mitch McConnell and his agenda to ban abortion nationwide.

Their positions are horrifying.

I won’t let my opponents – or anyone else – pull us back like this, and neither should you Granite Staters and families across the country deserve better.
**[Please take action by rushing $3 or whatever you can to my reelection campaign before our deadline tomorrow. Our numbers for the quarter will be made public, and they’ll be used as a gauge to assess Republicans’ chances at rolling back even more of our fundamental rights.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47173435/353329751/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=3&refcode=mh-jtk1233-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkYjc3ZGUxNi0wNGY4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GCWjhvnCtz3dvXvNwb2LmYCZtnSBoTBg4_KQtsY_5Mc=)**

With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

We’re running out of time, and I know you’re busy, so I’ll give it to you straight: I’m facing my biggest deadline of the cycle tomorrow, and I need to know if in the next 15 minutes? I’m running in a toss-up seat against an extremely vulnerable radical Democrat, and our fundraising numbers this quarter will DETERMINE the election. Here’s what I didn’t want to have to send you: my team and I are going over the numbers before our biggest end-of-quarter deadline, and we’re 26% short and running out of time. My super-DEM opponent and the liberal media will be patiently waiting to comb through my next round of publicly accessible finance reports so they can spot potential weaknesses or shortcomings that they can use against me. Why, you may ask? Because this has been labeled as one of five top races that will determine the House majority – and Democrats are worried about this seat. They’ve marked my opponent as vulnerable and called on Dark Money groups to dump millions into my opponents bank account, because they know she’ll rubber stamp Pelosi’s America-last agenda. This is the same far-left Democrat who beat me in 2020 by just 2% and since then has voted with Pelosi 98% of the time. So now you see why I had to email you and ask for your immediate support. If Republicans are going to retake control of the House, then it’s essential to win seats in suburban district like the one I’m running in. With just four seats needed to take control, we must PUT EVERY SINGLE SEAT IN PLAY. We are entering into the most important midterm election of our lives. What happens now, will determine what our kids’ futures look like. It will determine the future of America. If that is not worth fighting for, I don’t know what is. Winning this seat means winning back the House majority for Republicans , and well, losing means... Democrats will have the chance to go wild. It’s time to fire the politicians who HATE America and restore our country. In service, Tyler Kistner Father. Husband. Friend,

American women's rights to reproductive privacy have become a campaign issue, and I want to make my position clear to voters.

To be brief:**I am a pro-choice Catholic, and I support codifying Roe v. Wade into law.**

Reproductive privacy is not an issue I wanted to run on. I wanted to run on defending our democracy from an increasingly anti-democratic GOP and on making our forests less fire prone in a time of climate change. Unfortunately, we now face a third danger to our lives, our liberties, and our pursuit of happiness: a radicalized Supreme Court determined to tear up precedent and impose right-wing cultural beliefs on all Americans.

There are two major issues with the decision that overturned Roe v. Wade: the threat posed by the decision and the decision itself.

First, I want to emphasize the danger of a hyper partisan Supreme Court determined to weaponize their Constitutional powers to impose Republican policy preferences with no respect for the democratic process. This is a threat to our tri-part system of government and is not how the judicial branch is supposed to work. Courts should NOT be making policy. They should be - in the words of Justice Roberts - "calling balls and strikes" of actions of the executive and legislative branches.

Second, the decision itself is a disaster for women. Outlawing abortion will not make abortion disappear. It will not make the situations in which abortion is required to save the life or the uterus of a woman whose pregnancy has gone tragically wrong disappear. In states that outlaw or severely restrict abortion, elective abortion will continue to be available to women who can afford to travel out of state, but poor women will be forced to turn to dangerous illegal providers. In states that outlaw or severely restrict abortion, every pregnant woman is in danger of dying from refusal of medical care if she miscarries incompletely. A woman's rights to reproductive privacy and to life itself are core components of individual liberty, and the revocation of these rights by the only unelected branch of our government only serves to highlight the anti-democratic tendencies of the modern GOP.

On a more personal note, **I oppose elective abortion but do not want our government to impose my opposition on others.** Part of being a responsible citizen in a multicultural democracy is accepting the limits of my personal beliefs and recognizing the rights of my fellow citizens to hold opposing beliefs. **Too many Republicans have forgotten how to be good neighbors and good citizens.**

Taking a wider view of where we are now in our history, I am very concerned about the rise of Christian nationalism within the GOP and within GOP-controlled institutions. Lauren Boebert recently called for an end to the separation of church and state. Boebert may be on the fringe, but she speaks for many in the GOP and her faction seems ascendant. The silence from her GOP colleagues on this issue is too loud to ignore.

**[We have a chance to defeat extremism by ousting Doug LaMalfa and others like him. clean_body: | = Friend, American women's rights to reproductive privacy have become a campaign issue, and I want to make my position clear to voters. To be brief:I am a pro-choice Catholic, and I support codifying Roe v. Wade into law. Reproductive privacy is not an issue I wanted to run on. I wanted to run on defending our democracy from an increasingly anti-democratic GOP and on making our forests less fire prone in a time of climate change. Unfortunately, we now face a third danger to our lives, our liberties, and our pursuit of happiness: a radicalized Supreme Court determined to tear up precedent and impose right-wing cultural beliefs on all Americans. There are two major issues with the decision that overturned Roe v. Wade: the threat posed by the decision and the decision itself. First, I want to emphasize the danger of a hyper partisan Supreme Court determined to weaponize their Constitutional powers to impose Republican policy preferences with no respect for the democratic process. This is a threat to our tri-part system of government and is not how the judicial branch is supposed to work. Courts should NOT be making policy. They should be - in the words of Justice Roberts - "calling balls and strikes" of actions of the executive and legislative branches. Second, the decision itself is a disaster for women. Outlawing abortion will not make abortion disappear. It will not make the situations in which abortion is required to save the life or the uterus of a woman whose pregnancy has gone tragically wrong disappear. In states that outlaw or severely restrict abortion, elective abortion will continue to be available to women who can afford to travel out of state, but poor women will be forced to turn to dangerous illegal providers. In states that outlaw or severely restrict abortion, every pregnant woman is in danger of dying from refusal of medical care if she miscarries incompletely. A woman's rights to reproductive privacy and to life itself are core components of individual liberty, and the revocation of these rights by the only unelected branch of our government only serves to highlight the anti-democratic tendencies of the modern GOP. On a more personal note, I oppose elective abortion but do not want our government to impose my opposition on others. Part of being a responsible citizen in a multicultural democracy is accepting the limits of my personal beliefs and recognizing the rights of my fellow citizens to hold opposing beliefs. Too many Republicans have forgotten how to be good neighbors and good citizens. Taking a wider view of where we are now in our history, I am very concerned about the rise of Christian nationalism within the GOP and within GOP-controlled institutions. Lauren Boebert recently called for an end to the separation of church and state. Boebert may be on the fringe, but she speaks for many in the GOP and her faction seems ascendant. | | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

When Vanity Fair joined me on the campaign trail, friend, here's what I told them: **When I make it to the U.S. Senate, it will not be the same._I will never tire of doing good. _**

**[If you're already committed to our movement to flip Florida blue, I'm asking you to give $5 now. If you aren't, friend, I'm hoping you'll give me a minute to explain to you why I'm running.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47175787/353358550/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3674-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDA5OWNmNi0wZmY4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dOd_YU_Rm_QJFwBWqqz1cWV08b27B3GyjgyTuckQO7E=)**
The way I see it, senators like my opponent, Marco Rubio, have forgotten who they serve. But from my long days and nights in Congress to even longer nights on the Orlando police beat, I've shown that I know what it means to truly give back. It is ingrained in me and I have my mom and dad to thank for that.
When my siblings and I were young (all seven of us!), Mom and Dad would tell us to define ourselves by our ability to work hard – by our belief in _ourselves._ "Never grow tired of doing good, Val, _never tire,_ " my mom would tell me. These are sentiments I hold close to my heart. Even though we grew up poor, even though life was tough sometimes, Mom and Dad instilled in me a sense of duty that's never wavered. **I'll bring this duty to the U.S. Senate, and when I do, the Senate will no longer be the same.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47175788/353358551/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3674-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDA5OWNmNi0wZmY4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dOd_YU_Rm_QJFwBWqqz1cWV08b27B3GyjgyTuckQO7E=)
Photo credit: Vanity Fair and Annie Leibovitz
The sad thing about career politicians like Marco Rubio, friend, is that they don't truly _see_ people anymore. It's something I lived through growing up in poverty. As I told Vanity Fair recently, people would walk by my parents like they weren't even there. Like being a janitor and a maid raising seven kids in the segregated South didn't _matter. _

That's why I speak so often to strangers here in Florida and invite them back to my office to chat. It's why in Congress I always remember to strike up a chat with painters, janitors, cafeteria workers – the hardworking Americans that are the backbone of our nation's capital. I want people to know I see them. I want people to know they're here, and they _matter._**I'll bring this humanity to the U.S. Senate, and when I do, the Senate will no longer be the same.**
**[If you're ready for change in the U.S. Senate, if you believe in the opportunity to do good and truly tackle the challenges before us, then I'm asking you to help me win. Pitch in a contribution of $5 or more now to help me defeat Marco Rubio, win in Florida and defend our Senate majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47175789/353358552/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3674-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDA5OWNmNi0wZmY4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dOd_YU_Rm_QJFwBWqqz1cWV08b27B3GyjgyTuckQO7E=)**
After long days on the campaign trail, Mom's words – _never tire –_ resonate in my mind. They're what I hear when I remember gun violence striking my community at Pulse nightclub in Orlando – resolving me to fight for change, to never tire, until the epidemic of gun violence in America is no more.

_Never tire,_ the words I hear as more and more truth comes out about the habitual offender who occupied the most powerful office in the world: former President Donald Trump. Nobody is above the law, and I'll never tire to hold him accountable for what he's done to our democracy.

**_Never tire,_ the words I'll hear when I make it to the U.S. Senate. And because a little Black girl grew up with so much grit – because her parents, a maid and a janitor, taught her to persevere – the Senate will no longer be the same.**
**[But I need your support, friend. This campaign is a battle of many things, and an unfortunate reality among them is _resources. _The Republican Party is already proving they will spend whatever it takes to protect Marco Rubio, so if you're with me, if you want to change our U.S. Senate and entire country for the better, please donate $5 or whatever you can right now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47175790/353358553/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3674-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDA5OWNmNi0wZmY4LWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dOd_YU_Rm_QJFwBWqqz1cWV08b27B3GyjgyTuckQO7E=)**
Thank you for being in this with me. _Never tire._

Val Demings

clean_body: If you're ready for change in the U.S. Senate | | | = When Vanity Fair joined me on the campaign trail, friend, here's what I told them: When I make it to the U.S. Senate, it will not be the same.I will never tire of doing good. = The way I see it, senators like my opponent, Marco Rubio, have forgotten who they serve. But from my long days and nights in Congress to even longer nights on the Orlando police beat, I've shown that I know what it means to truly give back. It is ingrained in me and I have my mom and dad to thank for that. When my siblings and I were young (all seven of us!), Mom and Dad would tell us to define ourselves by our ability to work hard – by our belief in ourselves. "Never grow tired of doing good, Val, never tire, " my mom would tell me. These are sentiments I hold close to my heart. Even though we grew up poor, even though life was tough sometimes, Mom and Dad instilled in me a sense of duty that's never wavered. I'll bring this duty to the U.S. Senate, and when I do, the Senate will no longer be the same. = Photo credit: Vanity Fair and Annie Leibovitz The sad thing about career politicians like Marco Rubio, friend, is that they don't truly see people anymore. It's something I lived through growing up in poverty. As I told Vanity Fair recently, people would walk by my parents like they weren't even there. Like being a janitor and a maid raising seven kids in the segregated South didn't matter. That's why I speak so often to strangers here in Florida and invite them back to my office to chat. It's why in Congress I always remember to strike up a chat with painters, janitors, cafeteria workers – the hardworking Americans that are the backbone of our nation's capital. I want people to know I see them. I want people to know they're here, and they matter.I'll bring this humanity to the U.S. Senate, and when I do, the Senate will no longer be the same. = After long days on the campaign trail, Mom's words – never tire – resonate in my mind. They're what I hear when I remember gun violence striking my community at Pulse nightclub in Orlando – resolving me to fight for change, to never tire, until the epidemic of gun violence in America is no more. Never tire, the words I hear as more and more truth comes out about the habitual offender who occupied the most powerful office in the world: former President Donald Trump. Nobody is above the law, and I'll never tire to hold him accountable for what he's done to our democracy. Never tire, the words I'll hear when I make it to the U.S. Senate. And because a little Black girl grew up with so much grit – because her parents, a maid and a janitor, taught her to persevere – the Senate will no longer be the same. = Thank you for being in this with me. body:
Hey there — it’s Hannah. We’re about to make a really tough decision.

This cycle, we’ve got our biggest slate of campaigns ever. And just last Friday in the wake of the news on Roe, we let you know that we were adding another campaign to our slate that would protect reproductive freedom in Vermont.

Here’s the truth: we’re pretty tight on resources. We know how important it is that we power campaigns like the ones in Michigan & Vermont, especially now that the fight for reproductive health care has gone to the states. But we may have to scale back our efforts for our ballot measure campaigns this cycle if we don’t meet our goal this quarter.

Scaling back means we’ll have to cut polling, TV ads, and rethink our plans to go door-to-door educating voters on the importance of each campaign.

I don’t want to have to make those tough choices – which means we need supporters like you to chip in what you can to help us make up the difference.

If each of our supporters pitches in $15 or more, we’ll hit our end-of-quarter goal and be able to cut the full checks we were hoping to for each of our campaigns.

Here’s a secure link from my team that you can use to contribute: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/TFPUS-ALL-Email-June2022-FR-endofjunematch?refcode=E16717-20220629-EOQ4-SL-CampaignNews-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/TFPUS-ALL-Email-June2022-FR-endofjunematch?refcode=E16717-20220629-EOQ4-SL-CampaignNews-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=25]

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last night, all of the big corporate campaign money, the establishment
Super PACs, Nancy Pelosi and Pres. Biden’s endorsements — it was all too
much to overcome. Kina Collins narrowly lost her primary against a
longtime corporate Democrat.

It’s always disappointing when we come up short. But when Kina spoke last
night, she looked towards a better future. She said, "This is not a
concession speech... this will not be the end, we are just getting started."

Our movement is about organizing, fighting, and, most importantly, not
giving up. We know the Democratic establishment has access to unlimited
campaign money from Wall Street, fossil fuel companies, and health
insurance companies. We know corporate Democrats are willing to take money
and campaign support from GOP mega-donors and right-wing foreign policy
hawks.

We know this fight has never been easy and it won’t be easy in the days,
months, and years ahead. But we have the people on our side and we won’t
stop building towards a better future — a future where everyone has health
care, a home, a livable planet, no student debt, and much more.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110946?refcode=em20220629-24069&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=24069%2E1203867%2ExXswnc ]Peter, can
you help us keep building towards a better future with a $3
contribution today? We need your support to go up against the big money of
the establishment.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110946?refcode=em20220629-24069&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=24069%2E1203867%2ExXswnc ]Contribute

Pres. Biden endorsed against Kina. Nancy Pelosi campaigned and fundraised
for Kina’s opponent for months. Corporate super PACs spent at least
$500,000 against Kina. Fossil fuel companies, private prison groups, and
big Republican donors all made big contributions to try to defeat Kina and
our movement.

But we still came together and helped lift a young, progressive, community
organizer within a few points of defeating the establishment.

We’ve shaken the political establishment before, when we helped elect AOC
in 2018, and Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman in 2020. And earlier this year,
we helped Summer Lee and Greg Casar win big primaries against corporate
Democrats.

The Kansas State Rifle Association today endorsed Scott Schwab for a second term as Secretary of State | | | |
---
| | | Friends,

I have some exciting news to share with you:

The Kansas State Rifle Association today endorsed me for a second term as Kansas Secretary of State! Read their full statement [HERE](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=5e6e980cfc&e=e4cd931cf2).

During my time in the Kansas legislature, I was honored to sponsor the Second Amendment Protection Act and support bills that protect Kansans' right to bear arms. As my children learn gun safety and hunter education, it is my priority to ensure their constitutional rights are thoroughly protected.

While Democrats are attempting to deny Second Amendment protections for law-abiding citizens, Kansans must stand up to defend their constitutional rights.

It is humbling to be endorsed by conservative organizations fighting for our constitutional rights. I look forward to a second term in office supporting efforts to protect the Second Amendment.

Respectfully,

Secretary of State

## 1/6 Committee Digest
Country First presents the next edition of The Digest to highlight the important work of the 1/6 Committee. Our aim is to make this available to our members within 24 hours after each hearing. **MARK YOUR CALENDARS FOR THE NEXT HEARING:** **TENTATIVELY TUESDAY, JULY 12** **Don't Miss It:**

* **Cassidy Hutchinson** , Special Assistant to Mark Meadows, Donald Trump’s Chief of Staff

Here are the major developments from the committee: **Top Trump Aide Reveals Inside Information About Jan. 6th ** Former President Donald Trump was reportedly angry that armed protestors were not allowed to enter the site of his January 6th rally outside the White House with their weapons, saying something to the effect of "they're not here to hurt me." He even went so far as to [affirm](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=zveC7zroragI2qrXZZ9Nau8g06OiiFSrYZB4vdSsTxxol28Dp7GJmGfYfuAzD-_Ddo8Dq-oeoivpUnt586PXxyTA_fpy0HNkzMVIoKoyMZ_3umpQs1zrGu83xKpA2mYr5nue_wMOaGKVTKPZuoj9KA&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=5) their calls to "hang Mike Pence" and told officials to "let my people in" when they began to push towards the Capitol. This and more were included in the testimony of Cassidy Hutchinson, former Special Assistant to Mark Meadows (Trump’s Chief of Staff at the time). Hutchison’s testimony depicts Trump as angry, unstable, and prone to violence. Hutchinson testified that Trump lunged to try to gain control of the presidential SUV after being told by security that it wasn’t safe for him to go to the Capitol in the wake of his speech to the protesters. Though it is unclear what Trump’s plans would have been once he made it to the Capitol, Hutchison attested that there were plans for Trump to "go into the House chamber at one point." Speaking to his angry tendencies, Hutchinson said after an AP article was published stating the Department of Justice had found no evidence of voter fraud that she and a White House valet cleaned up the Oval Office dining room after Trump threw the contents of the dining table (including his lunch) at the wall. During the events of the 6th, Trump tweeted that Pence needed to have the "courage" to stop the certification of the election results. Hutchinson also confirmed that Meadows observed Trump was not worried about the protesters' calls to hang Pence, rather saying that "he deserved it" and that the protesters weren’t "doing anything wrong." Leading up to the 6th, Hutchinson said she was "scared, and nervous of what could happen" if things took a turn for the worst and that Meadows had warned her that "things might get real, real bad." She also discussed meetings leading up to the election where Trump was cautioned against enlisting fake electors in swing states. Hutchinson concluded her testimony saying that she is disgusted by the events of January 6th and is struggling to come to terms with them. **Former President Knew Weapons Were Present On January 6th** Anthony Ornato, then Deputy Chief of Staff for Operations, [told](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=PiInCVHjZg_Lhb0RQ-dhd3nupceIa8DuTdOzvpYk6G1l__S6LTtA8lro1CwzhSSiTxC3TUgQGhz390HNLTl4dDIZ0VpnpO4hs36couKXOjqXc3URUjP1Cu4FLxC9gZ5h-eVEH1i6doFoua1wMURj_fQzym-0uFF2kBYdElJy9yalNnt4Qs3K19YFykPgo5hxDF7YYVDZk6iQU9hcIQlWjUkfiZBaX9XQE13zrx3U2KnrTiNDKpdBHB-szKuZRPlgdma2OEsLaIGUZPI7RcKJcMLymZcTRm98kmcIF2iqs_82A01hnYP8P8kgKHWNAOuj&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=6) Mark Meadows, then Chief of Staff, that he had informed Trump about the armed crowd before Trump’s Ellipse speech at the January 6th rally, Hutchinson testified. Hutchinson stated that Trump was upset that turnout at the rally was limited by magnetometers (metal detectors) that preventing supporters from attending who did not want their weapons confiscated. Hutchinson testified she overheard Trump saying something to the effect of, "I don’t f—ing care that they have weapons. They’re not here to hurt me. Take the [metal detectors] away. Let the people in, they can march to the Capitol from here." After telling his supporters that he would join them at the Capitol after the rally, Trump expected his Secret Service contingent to drive him there. Hutchinson described Trump as furious and out-of-control when the Secret Service denied his demands due to the danger of the situation. Trump then tried to force his limousine to the Capitol, but instead was returned to the West Wing of the White House where he observed the riot on TV. The President didn’t think the crowd was doing anything wrong, according to Hutchinson's testimony. After the riot began at the Capitol, Hutchinson said Meadows had an eerily nonchalant reaction as he learned details of the escalating violence at the Capitol. "I remember distinctly Mark not looking up from his phone," Hutchinson [recalled](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=ByhkdA7RrYhHtdiUMWUYvDoU31aLiS3EgmUxpTQDTvHVvF1p7NHcLlK1LeHXlURi-w7NksqBNd1HSTw6qI-xDZENFnkPon_kCNNRQd7-Hph1UjCNGkd1SnXB3LnB63-p&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=7). White House Counsel Pat Cipollone told Meadows he needed to talk to Trump and [urge](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=OwehQGnYjrzpIc0rxaR28RjPKIZFv_YrxlIEOaKNZWFsvTGaRzAVp5mkFnfJ1EJjqW0dbXT9eH5YjVYa927vpYuuUmYUfr435cjbiyugLujyDkhgyUoLdLELZ2kdC9tHhO62IWfSDRW8HUm5I51mHkUvUWdWA3uL5o7JQ0M99xU&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=8) him to do something to stop the riot. Hutchinson testified that she overheard Cipollone, after a conversation with Trump, tell Meadows that "we need to do something more, they’re literally calling for the Vice President to be effing hung." Meadows replied, "You heard him, Pat, he thinks Mike deserves it. He doesn’t think they’re doing anything wrong." Hutchinson recalled how she felt witnesses the desecration of the Capitol: "It was un-American...We were watching the Capitol building get defaced over a lie." **Hutchinson Recalls Altercation Between Former President and Secret Service** In bombshell testimony given by Cassidy Hutchinson on Tuesday, Hutchinson recalled an incident in which she was informed about former-President Trump [lunging](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=2iaT83uNu1cFema6WFDKfAP7OgPbyT49YDsVIl70DhYv2Q_M53ijzwy2LOCDOLgcm7NWs-W9oA1Ap4UxW_lla8g7JSzbV0T-lQIn7rIlAKogsSNAuSvtENnJ782HG_FvfdUxIVQ95uqU-P3ISp1vnUswLsNGLRfZMS2HrnF5hc5HIioYp0KpDZW4kjQSC580IYKV6p5A6trre5Ted33sFw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=9) at the Secret Service after they refused to drive him to the Capitol following his rally speech on January 6th. According to Hutchinson, the former President was notified that they would not be taking him to the U.S. Capitol building due to safety concerns. Despite being told numerous times that they were going back to the West Wing of the White House, the former President refused to accept their answer. "'I'm the 'effing' president, take me up to the Capitol now!'" Hutchinson testified she was told the President said by those present. Hutchinson futher testified that after yelling at his security, Trump then lunged for the steering wheel of the SUV, attempting to overtake the vehicle and detour to the U.S. Capitol. He was [restrained](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=Y1JQzDDPf_G40AL8Qe4864hh8bSPOwsCL0TC4KsjgU5o_bOaDmowm4Hw4gh_EUn7SRqaYaKZaupOXx7kfZ9RD5HKVdRuCgKs6_NxSE-P6228CTMnFm_xLNnwWWOqqZqepg3StyRDQM7jutZgAFUDU0wtKRN1dZ-8n8FhiwPGFvEUkGHw6g8G10ZriJ7b7oFr&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=10) by his security, only to lunge at Bobby Engel, a Secret Service Special Agent. The former President has denied these allegations. **White House Counsel Warned Former President About Legal Woes** Former White House Counsel, Pat Cipollone, [warned](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=Y5Xlf9pA_AJcYmYaz2zF4F9jHT6J9Ro9V2MAAoIxXRbkj-wQPDgp3cuYyvEHI_bMsD-oaOrg8qFXgPYOscWyDbKb_qSUlNlgN2xKu4zomEU&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=11) the former President and his team of the possible legal issues with attending the protest-turned-insurrection at the United States Capitol. In testimony given by former Chief of Staff Aide Cassidy Hutchinson, she laid out the mindset of the White House Counsel as they begged the former President not to attend the march to the Capitol. "Pat was concerned it would look like we were obstructing justice or obstructing the electoral college count ... that it would look like we were obstructing what was happening on Capitol Hill, and he was also worried that it would look like we were inciting a riot or encouraging a riot to erupt on the Capitol,” Hutchinson said in sworn testimony. She recalled the President’s insistence on being at the Capitol building with his supporters. Former White House Press Secretary, Kayleigh McEnany, corroborated Ms. Hutchinson, saying "He said he wanted to physically walk with the marchers." However, Cipollone begged the former President’s inner circle to deny him from going to the Capitol, saying: "We're going to get charged with every crime imaginable if we make that movement happen." **Committee Warns Trump’s Camp Against Witness Tampering** While Hutchinson’s brave testimony was the focus of the surprise hearing on Tuesday, the panel issued a stark warning to members of the former President’s inner circle: Stop obstructing justice. In a closing statement made on Tuesday, Vice Chair Liz Cheney thanked Hutchinson and other Republicans for their bravery; going against the leader of their party and telling the truth. Cheney [revealed](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=7EL176YFyxKF3ox3wD2rUa9NE6ywFnrLgtdqrAFoFkWKDE7I4DNWcoFZqccfh9Re-91YAkFc6WJ8VN4hscIctEPcxd2u_GNEI3yTfIYIAGsGgdNY51GS3MdBKq9yjqT6&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=12) that those who may be willing to testify are reluctant to do so because they have been contacted by the former President and/or his inner circle. The 1/6 Committee presented text messages [shared](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GUadKUZbNtXpoQtrN7XiLlDAp0T1nvsEvUIUmB084zHzVUczPwwkbNhim_D72boSk8UCkwKSWhcoAyTmq0sPMXuURm3tmFYWuQPLDe86RGjvz3uLPVW3QGCLDwJlhjBhzbCbFKkbhT7O3qy4pTOGZg&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=campfire_16_digest_nd&n=13) with the committee by witnesses who faced such intimidation. In one instance, an anonymous witness said, "what they said to me is as long as I continue to be a team player, they know that I'm on the team, I'm doing the right thing, I'm protecting who I need to protect, you know, I'll continue to stay in the good graces in Trump world." Another said, "they have reminded me a couple of times that Trump does read transcripts and just keep that in mind as I proceed through my depositions and interviews with the committee." Although no names have been released regarding witness tampering, many suspect that was a motivation for the special hearing on Tuesday.

Peter,
One of the best ways to step up and guarantee that every woman in this country has equal rights is through building the bench at the state level.
Now that Roe is overturned and abortion access is decided on the state level, we need to elect pro-choice democratic women to state legislatures across the country.
We must take our fight to states to fight for women’s rights and for reproductive care. Will you join us in support? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moms4roevwade]
This is why we set a goal to raise $5,000 by tomorrow at midnight to support democratic moms running for office in states where abortion bans went into effect last Friday. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moms4roevwade]
In the United States, thirteen states, Arkansas, Idaho, Kentucky, Louisiana, Mississippi, Missouri, North Dakota, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, and Wyoming, enacted trigger laws that automatically ban (medically unnecessary) abortion in the first and second trimesters.
We must treat these state legislative races with urgency and allocate more resources to Democratic women candidates who have an opportunity to flip state houses across the country.

clean_body: What happened at a candidate forum. | | | Hey Peter, At a candidate forum hosted by The Tennessean last month, the moderator asked Odessa “If you could possess one superpower, what would it be and why?” Guess what she said: “I would give all men uteruses, and the ability to get pregnant and have babies, that way they would respect women to have autonomy of our bodies more.” Our rights are under attack from a radical GOP that wants to control the way people live. From the right to an abortion, to the right to vote, to LGBTQ rights, there’s nothing they won’t attack. The nutjobs in the Tennessee Republican Party, the extremists appointed for life on the Supreme Court, and, unfortunately, our current representative Mark Green are way more interested in dividing us up, telling people how to live and who to hate, rather than making this country work for working people. Odessa’s in this race to give voice and power to people who’ve been left behind by our political process — rural, urban, Black, brown, white, working class, LGTBQ, women, immigrants — we mean it, EVERYBODY. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: THANK YOU for your help! In solidarity, Odessa Kelly HQ | To give by check: Odessa for Congress 2817 West End Ave, Ste 126-401 Nashville, TN 37203

Hello,
Last week, the Supreme Court handed down their decision in _Dobbs vs. Jackson_. **This decision means that the Supreme Court has overturned**** _Roe v. Wade,_ and ****ended the constitutional right to abortion.**

name: Team AOC
subject: These races impact your direct life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
These races carry more power and impact on your life than you may realize.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220629-3150-header&t=1&akid=3150%2E2526796%2EauRF5Z)
Let's talk elections.
Since the SCOTUS decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , many Democrats have been telling folks that the solution is to vote. Yes, we need to vote, but “go vote” is way too broad and not helpful. What we need to do is focus on races that **really** matter.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220629-ctc.XPdP2x&refcode=em20220629-3150-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3150%2E2526796%2EauRF5Z)
There are Democrats who feel entitled to their seats because they won them over 20 years ago. If an incumbent’s continued service isn’t helping people, if they’re instead serving corporations and lobbies, then we need to reevaluate and find leaders who are actually serving their communities and are ready to step up.
**That’s why Alexandria started Courage to Change as a political action committee to build infrastructure and support for candidates in races across the nation who pledge their support of strong progressive values and who are committed to social, racial, and economic justice.**
[A $3 contribution from you right now would help us power our small, but growing list of candidates who are dedicated to fighting for working families and building progressive power in their communities. Can we count on your $3 contribution right now?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220629-ctc.XPdP2x&refcode=em20220629-3150-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3150%2E2526796%2EauRF5Z)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220629-ctc.XPdP2x&refcode=em20220629-3150-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3150%2E2526796%2EauRF5Z)**
**State and local representation matters.** When we talk about the scariness of what happened on January 6, it's in part because there's a lot of state legislatures that are willing to support and even work toward overturning electoral college results.
That’s why this cycle, for the first time, [we endorsed several dozen local candidates in states across the country](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/10440?t=23&akid=3150%2E2526796%2EauRF5Z), including in races like district attorney — many of whom now have the power to decide whether or not they’re going to prosecute their states’ anti-abortion laws. Some of these races may seem insignificant or “boring,” but the truth is that these races often carry enormous power and impact.
[Courage to Change is our political PAC looking to build progressive power by targeting races where voting really matters. Make a $3 contribution right now to power Courage to Change’s work to elect progressives down the ballot and across the nation who will actually serve our communities.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220629-ctc.XPdP2x&refcode=em20220629-3150-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=3150%2E2526796%2EauRF5Z)
Pa’lante!
— Team AOC
